### [72] [Predicting Closed-Loop Performance of Latent World Models: Offline Checkpoint Selection for MPC and Model-Based RL Under Non-Markovian Rewards in LunarLander](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01736)
*Nikolai Smolyanskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对隐式世界模型（RSSM）训练中难以离线选择最佳检查点的难题，提出了一套基于经典控制理论的可控性/可观性结构化验证指标（共40项），其中 Reward Observability Fraction (ROF) 与闭环性能相关性最强（Spearman ρ_s = -0.71）。进一步将 ROF 与三个结构正则项融合为单一评分 Composite Reward Observability Fraction (CROF)，可在无需环境交互的前提下精准定位最优检查点。在 LunarLander-v3 上，CROF 选出的世界模型驱动的 model-based A2C 策略以约 65 倍更少的真实环境交互超越 model-free A2C 基线约 24.5 分，且同一世界模型还能驱动零样本 CEM-MPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于模型的强化学习中，世界模型的训练目标（预测精度）与最终用途目标（闭环控制性能）之间存在"目标错位"问题（objective mismatch）。具体表现为：验证损失与多步 RMSE 在训练后期持续单调下降，但闭环性能早已崩塌——这使得离线检查点选择极为困难。LunarLander-v3 因其基于势函数的奖励塑形（PBRS）和由 Box2D 内部标志门控的终止事件，导致奖励并非 (o_t, a_t) 的马尔可夫函数，这一非马尔可夫奖励结构正是放大目标错位的典型场景，也是本文的动机核心。

Method: 1) 在 LunarLander-v3 上训练 RSSM 世界模型（GRU 隐状态 d_h=256 + 随机潜变量 d_z=16，含独立 reward head）；2) 对每个 checkpoint 计算 40 项指标，分四类：验证损失分解（5项）、多步开环 rollout 误差（9项）、基于 Jacobian 的线性可控性/可观性分析（固定与时变两种线性化，21项，含 RCF/OCF/ROF 三个子空间对齐分数）、有限差分经验灵敏度（3项），再加 2 项 CROF 复合分数；3) 以 CEM-MPC（种群 N=384、精英 E=48、迭代 I=4、视界 H=25）的 20 episode 平滑均值为闭环性能 oracle；4) 提出 CROF = 归一化 ROF + α·(1-k_c) + α·(1-k_o) + α·e_obs，其中 α∈{0.5,1.0} 对应 CROF-A/B。

Result: 在 100 个 checkpoint 上：jac_rof_combined 与平滑 MPC 返回值的 Spearman 相关性达 -0.71（R²_q = 0.52），远超所有标准指标（val_loss、post_rmse、ol_obs_avg 等均落在弱相关带 |ρ_s|<0.10）；固定 Jacobian 线性化显著优于时变线性化。LunarLander 奖励可解释性实验显示：(o_t,a_t) 单独仅能解释约 29% 的奖励方差（R²=0.290），加入 o_{t+1} 并滤除终止步后升至 97.1%，证实奖励的非马尔可夫性。Reacher 对照实验（R²=0.9998，ROF ρ_s=+0.143）反向验证 ROF 仅在非马尔可夫奖励条件下携带强信号。检查点选择：raw CROF-A/B 最小值均落在 epoch 280（MPC 返回 +162.8），处于 260–320 高性能平台内；val_loss 等标准指标则选出 epoch ≥460 的过拟合检查点（MPC 仅 +3 至 +79）。最终 CROF raw 选的 WM 280 训练出的 model-based A2C 取得 mean return +217.48（79/100 完美着陆），以约 65.3 倍更少的真实环境交互超越 model-free A2C 基线（+193.04）约 24.5 分；零样本 CEM-MPC 在同 WM 上亦达 +166.60。

Conclusion: CROF 在 LunarLander-v3 上以零真实环境评估成本匹配了 CEM-MPC oracle 的检查点选择能力，证实基于 Jacobian 的子空间对齐诊断可有效识别适合闭环控制的世界模型结构。结构洞察包括：潜空间可控性秩仅 33–47/272（约 12–17%），GRU 门控保留历史信息于其余维度；过拟合本质上是结构性的——多步预测误差继续改善时，奖励/观测/可控子空间已偏移出对齐状态。本文将 CROF 定位为针对非马尔可夫/塑形奖励这一常见结构条件的专用指标而非通用域度量，未来工作方向包括跨环境验证、将 ROF 作为训练正则项以及面向 A2C 策略自身的离线检查点选择指标。

Abstract: We study how to predict the downstream closed-loop performance of a learned latent world model from validation-time diagnostics alone. Choosing the right checkpoint from a world-model training run is difficult: validation loss and multi-step prediction RMSE keep improving long after closed-loop performance has collapsed. We present a suite of structural validation-time diagnostics drawn from optimal-control theory and apply them to Gymnasium's LunarLander v3, which features shaped rewards. We train an RSSM [5, 4] world model on it and treat per checkpoint CEM-MPC return as the oracle for closed-loop quality. By evaluating 40 metrics against this oracle, we find that the strongest single predictor is the Reward Observability Fraction (ROF), which measures the reward predictor's dependence on the observable subspace. We combine ROF with three structural regularizers into a single-number offline checkpoint selection score, the Composite Reward Observability Fraction (CROF). The CROF-selected world model trains a model-based A2C policy that beats a fairly evaluated model-free A2C baseline by ~24.5 return points while using ~65x fewer real-environment interactions, and the same world model also drives a strong zero-shot CEM-MPC policy. Code and data: this https URL .

</details>


### [73] [EPnG: Adaptive Expert Prune-and-Grow for Parameter-Efficient MoE Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01789)
*Ahin Lee,Sehyun Yun,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EPnG（Expert Prune-and-Grow），一种面向 MoE 模型的自适应参数高效微调框架。该方法根据路由器门控概率推导的专家重要性分数，对 LoRA 容量进行剪枝-生长动态再分配，在固定参数预算下显著优于静态 LoRA，并在仅更新 0.55%–0.72% 参数的情况下达到与全量微调相当的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 模型虽然通过稀疏激活实现高效推理，但在微调阶段面临两大挑战：（1）专家利用率高度不均衡，部分专家频繁被激活而部分几乎闲置，均匀参数分配造成浪费；（2）现有 PEFT 方法（如 LoRA）忽视 MoE 路由动态，对所有专家施加一致的更新，导致关键专家欠适配、不重要专家过度适配，造成资源利用效率低下。已有 MoE 感知 PEFT 方法或缺乏有效的再分配机制，或引入显著的参数开销。

Method: EPnG 采用"剪枝-生长"闭环机制，包含四个核心组件：（1）**专家重要性分数聚合**：在微调过程中收集路由器门控概率，按 token 平均得到每个专家的重要性分数 $\bar{p}_i$；（2）**低重要性专家剪枝**：按比例 $\alpha$ 剪除重要性分数最低的专家的 LoRA 参数，释放参数预算；（3）**高重要性专家生长**：按比例 $\beta$ 为重要性分数最高的专家扩展 LoRA 秩，通过拼接新低秩分量实现，且新方向 $A^{\text{new}}$ 经正交化处理以避免与现有子空间冗余（$A^{\text{new}} \leftarrow (I - QQ^\top)A^{\text{new}}$），$B^{\text{new}}$ 初始化为零；（4）**自适应再分配循环**：包含 $T_w$ 步预热阶段收集稳定的路由统计，之后每 $T_p$ 步触发一次剪枝-生长操作，并使用指数衰减因子 $\lambda$ 更新门控统计。在约束 $\alpha \geq \beta$ 下保证参数总量不超过初始预算。

Result: 在 OLMoE 和 Qwen1.5-MoE 两个 MoE 骨干上的实验表明：（1）OLMoE 上 EPnG 仅更新 0.72% 参数即超过 FFT（GSM8K: 66.26 vs 64.97）和静态 LoRA（平均 +1.73），且参数减少超 140 倍；（2）Qwen1.5-MoE 上 EPnG 以 0.55% 参数匹配 ESFT（平均均 58.98），但参数仅为 ESFT 的约 1/29，MATH（37.32 vs 34.96）和 HumanEval（74.39 vs 70.12）显著提升；（3）消融实验证实剪枝与生长互补（组合 66.41% > 单独剪枝 65.81% > 单独生长 64.97% > 基线 65.50%）；（4）EPnG 对基础秩选择更稳健，且倾向于将容量从浅层重新分配至深层；（5）专家重要性在微调前后发生显著变化，验证了动态再分配的必要性；（6）EPnG 较好保留了模型的通用能力（ARC-C/E、BoolQ），退化幅度小于 FFT。

Conclusion: EPnG 证明了将 PEFT 与 MoE 路由动态耦合是一条高效且可扩展的微调路径。专家级参数分配应被视为随训练动态演化的优化问题，而非固定的设计选择。该工作为大规模稀疏语言模型的路由感知自适应提供了新思路，未来可探索可恢复的剪枝机制以应对训练后期重要性反转的情况。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale efficiently but remain costly to adapt due to redundant experts and uniform parameter allocation. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA ignore MoE routing dynamics, leading to suboptimal resource use. We propose EPnG, an adaptive prune-and-grow framework that reallocates LoRA capacity based on expert importance derived from router gate probabilities. EPnG prunes under-utilized experts and expands high-importance experts via rank growth with orthogonal initialization, while maintaining a fixed parameter budget. Across OLMoE and Qwen1.5-MoE, EPnG consistently outperforms LoRA under the same budget and achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning while updating only 0.55%-0.72% of parameters (up to 140x-180x fewer). These results demonstrate that aligning PEFT with MoE routing yields a more effective and scalable fine-tuning strategy.

</details>


### [74] [Single-Channel EEG-Based Cognitive Load Assessment in Online Learning: A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01795)
*Rowan Hussein,Mohamed Ouf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一项可行性研究：使用单通道消费级EEG设备（NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2）配合混合CNN+LSTM+Attention模型，对在线学习中的认知负荷进行二分类（困惑/未困惑）。在9名受试者的被试内（within-subject）评估中达到78.5%的准确率，显著优于传统特征分类器的55%；并配套发布了开源的可复现评估管线与热力图可视化工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线教育中失去了教师可用的视觉反馈线索，难以及时识别学生感到困难的内容片段；EEG有望提供连续客观的认知负荷监测，但现有高精度方案依赖多通道设备和大数据集。本文动机是验证低门槛的单通道消费级EEG能否完成"易/难"内容区分，并强调当前小样本EEG研究中普遍存在被试内评估导致泛化性被高估的问题，倡导以被试独立（subject-independent，留一被试）评估为标准。

Method: 采用Wang等人公开数据集（10名受试者，剔除Subject #6后剩余9名），使用NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2单通道、~512 Hz的FP1位置信号。预处理后，将每个试次切分为短窗口（25/50/100样本），构造双输入混合模型：（1）CNN分支处理归一化后的原始波形（一维卷积+最大池化+批归一化）；（2）LSTM分支处理delta/theta/alpha/beta四维相对频段功率序列（长度10）；两分支均加入加性注意力层，融合后经全连接层+Dropout+L2正则化+Sigmoid二分类输出，损失函数为二元交叉熵。结合早停作为过拟合缓解措施，并发布了包含LOSO交叉验证、机会基线、标签置换显著性检验和分支消融的复现评估管线。

Result: 基线分类器（随机森林、XGBoost、SVM、逻辑回归、决策树、KNN等）在手工时域/频域特征上仅取得25%–55%的被试内准确率，多个模型接近或低于50%的机会水平。混合CNN+LSTM+Attention在被试内设置下达到最高78.5%准确率（窗口大小50样本；25/100样本时分别为75.0%与76.0%）。未正则化时训练精度持续上升而验证精度峰值约0.61后下降，呈现典型过拟合；加入Dropout与L2后，训练-验证曲线收敛于0.68–0.73区间。热力图可视化展示了对视频时间轴上的认知负荷推断结果，但仅为定性展示。

Conclusion: 研究表明，单通道消费级EEG结合混合深度模型可区分教育视频的难/易内容，被试内准确率显著高于传统特征分类器，正则化有效缓解了小样本过拟合。但作者明确指出：被试内评估在仅9名受试者条件下偏于乐观，且作为面向新学习者的系统，被试独立（LOSO）评估才是判断泛化性的合适标准——因此将本文定位为可复现的可行性研究而非可部署系统。未来工作重点是完成LOSO评估并报告显著性检验结果，以及扩展到多通道/多模态信号、更大规模与多样化的数据集、领域自适应与数据增强、以及可解释性方法，以最终支持在线学习平台中的实时个性化教学干预。

Abstract: Monitoring cognitive load during online learning could help instructors identify content that learners find difficult, but remote settings remove the visual cues that support this judgement in a classroom. We study whether a single-channel, consumer-grade EEG device (the NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2) can distinguish easy from difficult educational-video content, using the publicly available dataset of Wang et al. [24] (ten learners, one excluded for excessive noise, leaving nine). We implement a hybrid CNN+LSTM+Attention model that combines the raw waveform with band-power features. In a within-subject setting, the model reaches up to 78.5% accuracy, compared with 55% for conventional feature-based classifiers; regularization (dropout and L2) closes the large gap between training and validation accuracy that we observe without it, keeping validation accuracy stable at roughly 68-73%. We are deliberately cautious about these numbers: with only nine subjects, within-subject evaluation is optimistic, and we argue that subject-independent evaluation -- in which no learner appears in both training and test data -- should be the standard for this task. To that end we release a reproducible evaluation pipeline. We frame the work as a feasibility study rather than a deployable system, and pair it with an open, notebook-based tool that records EEG, runs inference, and visualizes estimated cognitive load as a heatmap over the video timeline to help educators locate potentially challenging segments.

</details>


### [75] [Expander Sparse Autoencoders: Parameter-Efficient Dictionaries for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01799)
*Rodrigo Mendoza-Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Expander SAEs，一种基于左d-正则expander掩码的参数高效稀疏自编码器架构，将学习到的解码器参数量从mn降至dn（d≪m），在Pythia、Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-1B上实现最高293×的参数压缩同时保留84%的dense CE恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准稀疏自编码器(SAE)的稠密解码器需要O(mn)个学习参数，当特征数量n较大时存储成本高昂；现有方法（Gated、JumpReLU、TopK、BatchTopK等）均保持稠密解码器，未探索解码器列稀疏性作为存储/可解释性约束的设计维度。此外，SAE推理本质上是压缩感知中的稀疏恢复问题，但未充分利用稀疏测量矩阵的结构优势。

Method: 1) 架构设计：将TopK SAE的解码器和绑定编码器限制在左d-正则expander图的邻接矩阵掩码上，仅学习dn个非零解码器值，保持稀疏编码问题(m,n,k)不变；2) 推理优化：利用d-正则结构将OMP的相关步骤从O(mn)稠密矩阵乘变为O(dn) gather-and-reduce，并实现GPU并行化（block Cholesky重拟合、Triton核）；3) 理论分析：证明在expander扩张性+列平坦性条件下k-稀疏编码的可识别性，并给出OMP支撑恢复的累积相干性充分条件；4) 实验验证：在四个不同规模的语言模型（Pythia-70M/160M、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-1B）上扫描d值，并在3个对照实验（簇稀疏、剪枝微调、参数匹配dense）中分离结构效应。

Result: 1) 存储-保真度前沿：跨模型一致，d=7时Qwen2.5-3B使用293×更少参数但保留84% CE恢复；2) 对照实验表明增益源于支持结构的多样性而非单纯参数减少——破坏多样性的簇稀疏掩码在d=200时死特征率上升100×；3) 现代LM规模上大部分dense差距是编码器摊销（amortisation）效应，迭代OMP施加于两者可将Llama上d=30匹配的dense基线差距从+0.060缩小至+0.007 CE；4) 激活Jaccard新颖性：d=7时达81%（vs dense-vs-dense 68%基线），表明低d Expander发现实质性不同的分解；5) 盲评LLM评判：d=200的Expander与Dense-SAE在1-5连贯性量表上统计不可区分（3.72 vs 3.59），d=7降至2.83但84%特征仍获具体概念标签；6) 理论定理3.1：在2β²ε<1条件下解码器无2k-稀疏零空间，稀疏解码问题恢复唯一k-稀疏解；推论3.2给出β²ε(2k+1)<1的OMP精确恢复充分条件。

Conclusion: Expander SAEs并非稠密SAE的最终替代方案，而是证明解码器支持结构是重要且被低估的设计轴心；其结构优势包括：(values,rows)扁平存储支持结构化OMP解码、确定性种子可再生掩码（8字节）、在NSP门限下小的d处的Pareto最优性。未来方向：更大规模评估、低秩修正、学习型稀疏支持、基于数据的更精确理论。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose internal activations of neural networks into sparse linear combinations of learned features by fitting an overcomplete dictionary $\mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ with $m<n$, and inferring a sparse code $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ from $\mathbf{h}\approx\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}$. This inference problem closely resembles the canonical setup of compressed sensing, but dense decoders requires $O(mn)$ learned values, which becomes costly at large feature counts. We introduce Expander SAEs: TopK SAEs whose decoder and tied encoder are supported on a left-$d$-regular expander mask with $d\ll m$, learning only $dn$ decoder values while keeping the sparse-coding problem $(m,n,k)$ fixed. The same structure reduces storage and turns the matching-pursuit correlation step $\mathbf{W}^\top \mathbf{r}$ in OMP into an $O(dn)$ gather-and-reduce operation. Our experiments show that across Pythia-70M/160M, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.2-1B residual-stream activations, varying $d$ traces a consistent storage--fidelity frontier, and that at the most compressed modern-LM setting, Qwen2.5-3B with $d=7$ uses $293\times$ fewer learned decoder values than the full dense decoder while retaining $84$% of dense CE-loss recovered. Control experiments show that the improved storage--fidelity tradeoff is driven by sparse, diverse decoder support structure rather than by fewer learned decoder values, and that when sparse and dense decoders are compared at matched parameter count, part of the remaining gap comes from encoder amortisation. On the theoretical side, we show that expansion and column flatness are sufficient for identifiability of noiseless $k$-sparse codes, and we derive complementary sufficient conditions under which OMP recovers the support exactly.

</details>


### [76] [Decomposer: Learning to Decompile Symbolic Music to Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01849)
*Yewon Kim,Apurva Gandhi,David Chung,Graham Neubig,Chris Donahue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Decomposer，一个用于符号音乐"反编译"的后训练框架，将符号 MIDI 音乐转换为可执行、可编辑的 Strudel 代码程序。该方法通过合成数据微调与强化学习两阶段训练，在 MIDI 重建保真度和代码可读性上均优于闭源大模型和启发式转换器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐表演本质上是高层乐谱指令的执行过程，但从表演（MIDI）逆向恢复出可编辑的高层音乐程序是一个具有挑战性的逆问题。直接优化 MIDI 重建容易退化为逐音符的"转录"，产生难以阅读的代码；同时 Strudel 作为一种小众音乐编程语言，缺乏天然的 MIDI-代码配对数据。需要一种既保证 MIDI 重建保真度、又产出可读可编辑高层代码的解决方案。

Method: 采用两阶段后训练框架：(1) 构建合成语料库 Strudel-Synth，生成配对的 Strudel 程序与渲染 MIDI，用于监督微调（SFT）；(2) 在无配对的 MIDI 数据上进行强化学习（RL），同时优化 MIDI 重建保真度奖励和代码可读性奖励（兼顾忠实性与可读性）。任务形式化为 MIDI-to-Strudel 反编译：输入符号 MIDI，输出执行后可重建输入的 Strudel 程序。

Result: 在合成与真实世界 MIDI 基准测试上的评估表明：Decomposer 在 MIDI 重建保真度上显著优于闭源大语言模型，同时生成的代码相比启发式转换器更具可读性和多样性。

Conclusion: Decomposer 验证了通过合成数据微调+强化学习后训练实现符号音乐反编译的可行性，能从 MIDI 恢复出既忠实于原曲又可读可编辑的高层音乐程序，为音乐生成与编辑提供了新的逆问题求解范式。

Abstract: Musical performance involves executing a set of high-level musical instructions, yet recovering those instructions from the performance is a challenging inverse problem. We present Decomposer, a post-training framework for symbolic music decompilation: the task of recovering executable, editable music programs from symbolic music. We instantiate the task as MIDI-to-Strudel decompilation, where the model takes symbolic MIDI as input and produces a program in Strudel, a music programming language, that reconstructs the input when executed. The task poses two challenges: Strudel is a low-resource language with little naturally paired MIDI-code data, and optimizing faithful reconstruction of MIDI alone can collapse to unreadable note-by-note transliteration. We address these challenges in two stages. First, we construct Strudel-Synth, a synthetic corpus of paired Strudel programs and rendered MIDI, and use it for supervised fine-tuning. Second, we refine the model with reinforcement learning on unpaired MIDI, optimizing rewards for both MIDI reconstruction faithfulness and code readability. Our evaluation across synthetic and real-world MIDI benchmarks shows that Decomposer achieves substantially higher MIDI reconstruction faithfulness than closed-source LLMs while producing more readable and diverse code than the heuristic converter.

</details>


### [77] [Rank-Then-Act: Reward-Free Control from Frame-Order Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01897)
*Yuriy Maksyuta,George Bredis,Ruslan Rakhimov,Daniil Gavrilov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Rank-Then-Act（RTA）框架,通过两阶段方法从专家视频中学习无环境奖励的控制策略:第一阶段使用GRPO训练VLM作为进度评分器,第二阶段利用预测进度排序与真实时间索引的Spearman秩相关系数作为强化学习的奖励信号,在离散和连续控制任务上均优于现有视频奖励学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在缺乏环境奖励的场景(如复古游戏、弱API模拟器、真实机器人)中,传统奖励设计脆弱且易被博弈;现有视频奖励模型存在三个问题:时间顺序导致"越后越好"的平凡捷径、绝对进度尺度跨任务模糊、在线学习需廉价且稳定的奖励信号。RTA旨在通过序数监督而非标量预测解决这些问题。

Method: RTA采用两阶段框架:Stage 1使用GRPO对打乱后的视频片段(首帧锚定)训练VLM作为listwise进度评分器,奖励为预测排名与真实时间戳的Spearman相关系数;Stage 2冻结评分器,在滑动窗口内计算L次随机排列的预测进度与时间索引的Spearman秩相关均值,作为PPO风格策略学习的唯一奖励信号(无任何环境奖励),使用VL-DAC或DrQv2作为策略骨干。

Result: 在PyBoy(Catrap L2/L4/L6、Kirby)和连续控制(PointMaze-UMaze、MetaWorld)任务上,RTA一致匹配或超越GVL、VLM-RM、Rank2Reward等基线:Kirby上唯一获得非零成功率,MetaWorld上door-open/close优于Rank2Reward;单一预训练评分器可跨游戏跨域迁移(YouTube、MetaWorld、COIN视频源);消融验证奖励设计而非模型架构是性能主因,中等窗口大小最稳定。

Conclusion: RTA证明仅依靠视频衍生的序数信号的相关系数监督即可实现有效的无奖励策略学习,为显式奖励设计提供可扩展替代方案,有助于避免奖励博弈,推动从专家视频学习通用智能体的发展。

Abstract: We introduce Rank-Then-Act (RTA), a framework for learning control policies from expert video demonstrations without environment rewards. RTA trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) offline as a progress-based ordinal scorer, using a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective over shuffled frame sequences, which forces the model to recover temporal ordering from visual semantics rather than trivial time cues. Importantly, instead of using the scorer directly as a scalar reward model, we propose a correlation-based reward function for reinforcement learning: at each interaction window, we compute the Spearman rank correlation between predicted progress rankings and true temporal indices, yielding a bounded, scale-invariant learning signal. This design decouples reward learning from absolute calibration and enables stable transfer across tasks and environments. We evaluate RTA on discrete control benchmarks (PyBoy: Catrap, Kirby) and continuous control tasks (PointMaze, MetaWorld). RTA consistently matches or outperforms prior video-based reward learning methods and rank-based baselines, while demonstrating strong cross-task reuse of a single pretrained progress scorer. Our results suggest that correlation-structured supervision over video-derived ordinal signals is sufficient for policy learning, offering a scalable alternative to explicit reward design.

</details>


### [78] [SABER: A Semantic-Aligned Brain Network Analysis Framework via Multi-scale Hypergraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01901)
*Yidan Xu,Xiangmin Han,Rundong Xue,Huihui Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SABER框架，通过多尺度超图建模与LLM语义对齐机制，将大语言模型（LLM）提取的语义知识从辅助特征提升为决策级推理组件，用于脑网络分析（fMRI）。该方法在ABIDE和ADHD-200数据集上实现了最先进的分类性能、稳定性及可解释性，尤其在小样本场景下表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑网络分析方法（如GNN、Transformer、Hypergraph）主要依赖结构化连接模式，忽略了临床语义知识的作用。虽然已有研究（如BrainPrompt、LLM-VEM）尝试引入LLM语义，但通常将其作为辅助特征或监督信号，无法直接参与决策过程，限制了在复杂高阶依赖建模、跨被试变异性处理及小样本任务中的鲁棒性。核心问题在于：语言语义能否在脑网络分类的决策过程中发挥主动作用，而非仅作特征增强？

Method: SABER框架由三个核心模块组成：（1）模块I——多尺度节点级编码：基于AAL图谱划分ROI，计算Pearson相关性得到初始特征；通过LLM生成ROI文本描述并编码，经线性投影与全局自注意力（BNT编码器）融合，实现全局语义传播；构建多尺度超图（k∈{1,5,10,15}），使用两层HGNN传播节点特征，再以共享多头自注意力（MHSA）统一跨尺度交互。（2）模块II——图级抽象：对每个尺度进行全局平均池化，通过可学习门控网络（softmax加权）自适应融合多尺度表示，得到被试特定的图嵌入。（3）模块III——决策级语义对齐：引入解耦于结构池化的Graph-CLS token，与图嵌入融合形成条件查询；通过跨注意力从患者元数据文本嵌入中检索相关语义；采用门控残差机制（sigmoid加权）动态调节语义注入强度；最终使用交叉熵损失与对比损失（对齐疾病级语义嵌入）进行双监督训练。

Result: 在ABIDE数据集上，SABER取得71.58%准确率、81.87%召回率和75.06% F1分数；在ADHD-200数据集上取得66.21%准确率和66.97% AUC，均优于BrainNetCNN、BrainGNN、BNT、Com-BrainTF、HGNN、BrainNPT、BrainGSL、MADEforASD及BrainPrompt等基线方法。消融实验验证了多尺度结构、共享注意力、动态融合、Graph-CLS及多级语义注入的必要性。批量大小16为最优设置，训练100 epoch达到性能峰值，8个注意力头为最佳。SABER_lite（无LLM语义）也已超越多数基线，证明结构建模本身的有效性。可解释性分析识别出梭状回、海马、眶部额下回、枕中回及后扣带回等ASD相关生物标志物。

Conclusion: SABER通过将LLM语义从辅助特征提升为决策级推理组件，结合多尺度超图高阶建模与门控自适应融合，实现了对fMRI脑网络分类的语义-结构协同增强。该框架在多个公开数据集上验证了优越性，并提供了具有神经科学意义的可解释性分析，为神经发育障碍诊断提供了融合结构连接模式与临床语义知识的新范式。

Abstract: Effective brain disease diagnosis requires the synergy of brain connectivity patterns and high-level semantic knowledge. Existing methods, however, largely treat semantics from large language models (LLMs) as auxiliary features or supervision, limiting their direct role in decision-making and constraining classification stability and robustness. To overcome this, we propose a semantic-aligned brain network framework that actively integrates LLM-derived semantics into the prediction process. Specifically, ROI-level semantics are first incorporated via global self-attention to enrich node representations and provide whole-brain context. Multi-scale hypergraphs are then constructed to explicitly model functional subnetworks and multi-ROI interactions, addressing the locality limitations of traditional GNNs and capturing high-order dependencies. Finally, a decision-level semantic alignment mechanism selectively injects patient-specific textual embeddings into graph representations, enabling semantics to directly guide predictions without perturbing the underlying network structure. Experiments on public brain network datasets ABIDE and ADHD-200 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, enhanced stability, and improved interpretability, particularly in small-sample settings.

</details>


### [79] [Population-Based Multi-Objective Training of Discriminators for Semi-Supervised GANs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01907)
*Francisco Sedeño,Francisco Chicano,Jamal Toutouh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 COMOD-SSLGAN，一种基于种群的 SSL-GAN 训练策略，将判别器学习建模为双目标优化问题（监督损失与无监督损失分离），采用 Pareto 优势进行选择，从而探索分类精度与真假判别之间的不同权衡。实验表明，精英变体在 MNIST 有限标签场景下达到最佳分类准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSL-GAN 训练不稳定，判别器需同时承担分类器与真假判别器双重角色。现有进化式 SSL-GAN 方法（如 CE-SSL-GAN）将监督损失和无监督损失聚合成单一标量损失，忽略了这两个目标本质上对应不同学习任务的特性，无法显式探索目标间的权衡关系。

Method: COMOD-SSLGAN 维护生成器与判别器两个大小为 μ 的种群，采用 (μ+λ) 竞争协同进化框架。将判别器训练建模为双目标最小化问题：min(L_D,s, L_D,u)。判别器通过 Pareto 非支配排序与拥挤距离（NSGA-II 风格）进行选择，生成器则按聚合生成损失选择。SGD 作为变异算子对耦合的 SSL-GAN 进行 n_t 轮训练。使用全对全（all-vs-all）匹配策略评估个体，并引入精英保留机制保留最优个体。还包括单目标消融变体（即 CE-SSL-GAN）用于对比分析。

Result: 在 MNIST 每类 100 个标签的有限标注设置下（30 次独立运行）：
• **分类准确率**：精英变体在 μ=5 和 μ=7 时均达到 0.90 中位数，较 SSL-GAN 基线（0.75）绝对提升 +0.15，相对提升约 +20%；即便 μ=1 的 base 变体也提升至 0.82（+9.33%）。Wilcoxon 检验（带 Bonferroni 校正，α<0.01）证实精英变体显著优于其他方法。
• **生成质量（SSIM）**：所有协同进化变体将 SSIM 从 0.32 提升至 0.38–0.41（相对提升约 18%–29%），但各变体间差异不显著。
• **种群规模效应**：μ>1 后增大种群并不持续带来提升，说明多样性比个体数量更重要。
• **训练动态**：随生成器质量提升，判别器准确率在后期出现下降，反映对抗博弈的动态特性。

Conclusion: 将多目标优化与竞争协同进化相结合可有效稳定 SSL-GAN 训练。Pareto 选择机制本身（即使在 μ=1 时）即可改善判别器性能与生成样本质量，精英保留机制进一步提升分类准确率与训练稳定性。未来工作方向包括：在 CIFAR-10、SVHN 等更复杂数据集上验证、将生成器训练也建模为多目标问题（兼顾保真度与多样性）、探索替代多目标选择策略，以及研究分布式实现以扩展种群规模。

Abstract: Semi-supervised generative adversarial networks (SSL-GANs) can exploit large unlabeled datasets while retaining a classifier in the discriminator, but their training is often unstable. This paper proposes a population-based evolutionary training strategy in which discriminator learning is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem. Instead of aggregating the supervised and unsupervised components of the SSL objective into a single scalar loss, the method maintains a population of discriminators ranked by Pareto dominance, enabling the exploration of different trade-offs between classification accuracy and real/fake discrimination. This formulation aims to improve both roles of SSL-GANs: learning accurate classifiers and training generators capable of producing realistic samples. We analyze several variants, including an elitist strategy and a mono-objective ablation, to assess the role of multi-objective selection. Experiments on MNIST with limited labels show improved training robustness compared to SSL-GAN and CE-SSL-GAN state-of-the-art baselines, while the elitist variant consistently achieves the highest classification accuracy.

</details>


### [80] [Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01940)
*Zhiren Gong,Zihao Zeng,Chau Yuen,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对Transformer自修复（self-repair）现象提出了一种无标签的二阶评分方法CoAx（条件协同消融），通过测量在移除主电路后各单元消融效应的"条件增长"来发现休眠的备份头，在GPT-2-small IOI电路上将备份头识别ROC-AUC从0.33提升到0.91，并在归纳任务上跨8个模型、6个架构家族迁移，同时改善了属性归因、能力击除和结构化剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机制可解释性中的电路发现、归因和剪枝多依赖一阶加性评分（即独立消融每个组件并测量输出变化），但当Transformer存在自修复（Hydra效应）时——主组件被移除后休眠的备份会接管——一阶评分会同时低估主组件和备份组件的重要性。GPT-2-small IOI中名称移动头模块呈现1.9倍超加性，导致属性归因被掩盖（消融主头仅使logit差下降0.22而非预期的2.53），现有自修复感知方法（如AtP* GradDrop）虽有所改善（0.82）但仍受限于节点加性形式。论文将这一失败重新定义为"条件电路补全"任务，目标是恢复那些仅在主电路被移除时才显现因果作用的组件。

Method: CoAx的核心是Fisher几何下的条件增长评分：(1) 使用Fisher加权中心化特征向量 δz̃_u = √p₀ ⊙ (δz_u - 𝔼_{p₀}[δz_u]·1) 测量消融效应的KL能量 ℰ；(2) 在主种子集𝒮被消融后，测量每个剩余单元的条件消融效应 δz_{u|𝒮} = z_𝒮 - z_{𝒮∪{u}}；(3) CoAx评分 comp_u(𝒮) = ℰ(δz_{u|𝒮}) - ℰ(δz_{u|∅}) 即条件消融能量的增长。算法复杂度为O(|𝒰|)前向传播，无需反向传播或任务标签，匹配但不超过一阶扫描。理论证明（命题2-3）表明：任何仅基于干净前向/反向统计的节点加性评分对纯备份和惰性单元不可区分（加性盲点），而comp_u(𝒮) ≈ 𝔼‖Σ_{s∈𝒮} Ĩ_{su}‖² 即休眠单元与种子协同的精确二阶信号。算法1（备份发现）执行单次消融基线+一次条件扫描；算法2（自修复感知剪枝）则顺序重新测量每步剩余单元的条件能量。

Result: 在GPT-2-small IOI（有标签的8个备份头）上，CoAx将备份头识别ROC-AUC从单消融的0.33提升到0.91，优于AtP (0.60)、GIM风格 (0.63)、EAP-IG (0.70) 和AtP* GradDrop (0.82)；反事实修补证实备份头因果承担了53-57%的自修复。CoAx还修复了被掩盖的属性归因（logit差下降从0.22→1.76，胜过文档化备份的1.15和随机集的1.0±0.7）；能力击除从0.97降至0.70匹配文档化oracle (0.72)，而一阶扩展则过度消融到0.24；剪枝在124M-7B四个模型50%稀疏度上WikiText-2困惑度均优于所有基线（GPT-2-small: 80.6 vs Taylor 201.4）。归纳任务上跨8个模型、6个架构家族（GPT-2/Neo、Pythia、Gemma-2、OLMo-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5）验证了标签自由的迁移能力（条件因果下降0.89 vs 随机0.05），但归纳冗余均匀分布导致"+own"控制与CoAx相当。控制冗余合成基准（100个植入备份）证实清洁态评分处于或低于随机水平（首阶能量0.42反向排序），而CoAx达0.90。局限性：8个文档化备份限制了统计功效；greater-than电路在头级和FFN组级均无强恢复；MLP介导的自修复是开放问题。

Conclusion: 组件重要性并非单元内在的孤立属性，而是相对于已移除组件的条件量；当Transformer通过冗余备份实现鲁棒性时，一阶加性评分会系统性漏掉使电路稳健的那些组件。CoAx将"自修复"重新框定为"条件电路补全"问题，通过O(|𝒰|)前向传播、无标签、输出接地的条件增长评分，恢复了被节点加性形式丢弃的二阶交互信号。理论（命题2-3）、受控合成基准和因果修补均支持该方法，统一了属性归因、能力击除和结构化剪枝的下游应用——忠实的鲁棒模型可解释性必须是条件性的：冗余不是应被平均掉的噪声，而是应被条件化的结构。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on component-level interventions to discover how a model produces a behavior. This guides attribution, capability knockout, and model pruning downstream to operate by scoring each unit by the effect of ablation in isolation. Such first-order scoring is natural when component importance is additive, but becomes misleading when a transformer self-repairs: after a primary component is removed, a dormant backup can take over, muting the primary's measured effect while the backup itself appears irrelevant on the intact model. We recast this failure as a recovery task, conditional circuit completion, and introduce Conditional Co-Ablation (CoAx), a label-free, output-grounded score that asks how much each remaining unit's ablation effect grows once a primary set has been removed. This conditional growth exposes the second-order interaction that single-unit scores discard. On the GPT-2-small IOI circuit, CoAx raises backup-head recovery from 0.33 to 0.91 ROC-AUC, outperforming all baselines, including self-repair-aware gradient scores (best 0.82); counterfactual patching verifies that the recovered heads causally carry the repair. The same label-free procedure transfers to induction across eight models. Beyond discovery, the recovered backups correct self-repair-masked attribution, identify the components required for capability knockout, and yield repair-aware structured pruning scaling from 124M to 7B. Component importance is therefore not merely an isolated-unit property: in robust circuits, the components that matter can become visible only under the interventions that make them necessary.

</details>


### [81] [Do Newer Lightweight CNNs Perform Better Under Resource Constraints? A Controlled Multigenerational Study of Architecture, Initialization, Training Budget, and Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01984)
*Tasnim Shahriar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控的多代际对比实验，评估了9个轻量级CNN模型包（2016–2024）在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny ImageNet上的预测性能与资源效率。研究发现：架构新颖度与下游性能之间不存在单调关系，新设计带来的是选择性而非普遍性的提升；EfficientNetV2-S在CIFAR任务上准确率最高，RepViT-M1.0在Tiny ImageNet上领先，EfficientNet-B0是各资源维度Pareto前沿中最一致的中间预算选择，MobileNetV3-Small在严重资源约束下表现最佳。GMACs与CPU延迟强相关但与GPU延迟弱相关，表明理论计算量无法可靠预测实际推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量级CNN常被宣称在预测性能和部署效率上有所改进，但此类声明需要在受控条件下进行评估。架构迭代迅速（2016至2024年），新模型多基于架构特定的预训练、增强、蒸馏和硬件目标发布，导致公开检查点在统一下游协议下的比较有实际价值但无法孤立架构因素。此外，资源受限的模型选择本质上是多目标问题（参数量、算力、内存、延迟、训练时间），单一指标无法反映部署需求。论文旨在回答：新架构是否在统一协议下提供一致优势，以及如何在不同资源约束下做出有依据的模型选择。

Method: （1）数据集：CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet，各保留10%训练集做验证。（2）模型：9个轻量级CNN（2016–2024），包括SqueezeNet1.1、ResNet18、MobileNetV2、ShuffleNetV2 x1.0、EfficientNet-B0、MobileNetV3-Small、EfficientNetV2-S（torchvision）和RepViT-M1.0、MobileNetV4-Conv-S（timm），均使用公开ImageNet-1K检查点。（3）统一下游协议：224×224输入、AdamW、cosine退火、20 epoch上限、标签平滑、混合精度、cuDNN确定性模式。（4）资源测量：参数量、FP32存储、GMACs、NVIDIA L4 FP16延迟、AMD Ryzen 5 5500U CPU延迟（1/4线程）、PyTorch CUDA峰值张量内存。（5）独立计算的逐点估计Pareto前沿。（6）EfficientNet-B0初始化与训练预算实验（20 vs 100 epoch）。（7）MobileNetV3-Small vs MobileNetV4-Conv-S的预训练与从头训练配对比较，含50,000次自助法置信区间与McNemar检验。

Result: 核心结果：（1）准确率——EfficientNetV2-S在CIFAR-10/100上分别达97.57%/86.98%，RepViT-M1.0在Tiny ImageNet上以79.87%领先；EfficientNet-B0在三个数据集上仅落后最佳0.22/0.85/1.79个百分点，但参数少约79%、GMACs少约86%。（2）资源——EfficientNet-B0出现在每个评估的精度-资源Pareto前沿上；MobileNetV3-Small的GMACs最低（0.0617），在两种CPU线程设置下均最快，并比MobileNetV4-Conv-S在三个数据集上均准确率更高。（3）MobileNetV4-Conv-S在预训练和从头训练下均未超过MobileNetV3-Small，从头训练时领先2.55/1.76/0.99个百分点，置信区间均不包含零。（4）初始化——EfficientNet-B0经100 epoch从头训练后仍比预训练低3.29/10.10/17.54个百分点，训练时间约为5倍。（5）延迟——GMACs与CPU延迟强相关（ρ=0.95），但与L4延迟弱相关（ρ=0.27）；ResNet18在L4上最快但CPU单线程下排名第七，MobileNetV3-Small则相反。（6）MobileNetV3-Small在严重算力和CPU延迟预算下提供最高观察精度；SqueezeNet1.1参数最少、CUDA峰值最小，但准确率显著较低。

Conclusion: 在所评估的模型池、数据集和执行环境中，架构新颖度并未带来一致的下游优势。新设计提供的是选择性增益而非普遍性提升：EfficientNetV2-S主导CIFAR任务，RepViT-M1.0在Tiny ImageNet上领先，EfficientNet-B0在所有资源维度上均处于Pareto前沿是最一致的中间预算选择，MobileNetV3-Small在严重资源约束下最优。研究表明单一资源代理指标不足：GMACs与CPU延迟强相关但与GPU延迟弱相关，峰值CUDA内存主要反映参数量。100 epoch从头训练虽改善EfficientNet-B0但仍有较大预训练差距，且评估的MobileNetV4-Conv-S模型包在测试检查点和从头训练协议下均未超越MobileNetV3-Small。因此结论是条件性的：新设计可改进特定数据集和部署配置，但模型选择仍取决于检查点来源、目标数据、优化预算、资源定义和完整执行环境。

Abstract: Newer lightweight convolutional neural networks are often presented as improving predictive performance and deployment efficiency, but such claims require controlled evaluation. This study compares nine lightweight CNN model packages across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet under a shared downstream protocol. We report top-1 accuracy, macro F1, top-5 accuracy, parameter count, FP32 storage, GMACs, batch-size-1 latency on an NVIDIA L4 and AMD Ryzen 5 5500U CPU, peak PyTorch CUDA allocated tensor memory, and point estimate Pareto frontiers. EfficientNetV2-S achieves the highest observed top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 at 97.57% and 86.98%, while RepViT-M1.0 leads Tiny ImageNet at 79.87%. EfficientNet-B0 remains within 0.22, 0.85, and 1.79 percentage points of the best result on the three datasets while using approximately 79% fewer parameters and 86% fewer GMACs than EfficientNetV2-S. It also appears on every evaluated accuracy and resource Pareto frontier, making it the most consistently competitive intermediate-budget option. MobileNetV3-Small has the lowest GMAC count, is the fastest model under both CPU thread settings, and records higher observed accuracy than MobileNetV4-Conv-S on all three datasets. Under random initialization, it leads MobileNetV4-Conv-S by 2.55, 1.76, and 0.99 points, with paired test-set intervals excluding zero for the fixed trained models. EfficientNet-B0 remains 3.29, 10.10, and 17.54 points below its pretrained counterpart after 100 epochs of scratch training, despite requiring about five times the recorded training time. SqueezeNet1.1 has the fewest parameters and lowest peak CUDA allocation, but substantially weaker accuracy. Latency rankings differ sharply between the L4 and CPU environments, showing that GMACs alone do not predict measured inference performance. Overall, newer designs provide selective rather than universal gains

### [82] [Beyond the Performance Illusion: Structure-Aware Stratified Partitioning and Curriculum Distributionally Robust Optimization for Spatially Correlated Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02055)
*Prathamesh Patil,Arpit Jain,Aswanth Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对空时相关领域（如航空监控、精准农业、医学影像）中标准随机划分导致的性能评估失真问题，提出了一个统一的评估与训练框架：结构感知分层划分（SASP）通过自监督语义聚类构造严格不重叠的验证折，课程式分布鲁棒优化（CDRO）通过渐进式难度加权稳定训练，在多个基准上显著提升了泛化能力和校准可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统的性能评估普遍假设数据集随机划分后训练/验证子集满足独立同分布（i.i.d.）。但在空时相关的数据采集场景中（无人机视频帧、相邻农田、患者扫描序列等），该假设常常失效，导致两类系统性失败：（1）空时泄露——高度相关的样本跨越训练集和验证集，造成性能虚高；（2）隐藏分层——少数关键子群体的错误被整体指标掩盖。这两类问题使得模型在真实部署中可能遭遇灾难性失败却未被检测到。

Method: 方法分为两个阶段。第一阶段为SASP（结构感知分层划分）：首先基于元数据或单样本构建原子单元，利用冻结的自监督视觉模型（如DINOv2）提取语义嵌入并取均值作为原型，通过余弦相似度构建图并以自适应阈值提取连通分量形成语义簇，最后采用"大簇约束优化+小簇贪心分配"的混合策略将簇分配至K折，同时保证结构不重叠与类别平衡。第二阶段为CDRO（课程式分布鲁棒优化）：将训练划分为T个阶段，按各组的难度分数Δ以指数加权方式更新采样概率P，逐步增加对困难/低表现子群体的采样权重，最后通过均匀采样+降低增强的稳定化阶段恢复校准。

Result: （1）SASP在VisDrone上将验证-训练近重复泄露降低98.5%；（2）在GWHD上无需元数据即可恢复与真实地理区域高度对齐的潜在语义聚类；（3）多个基准上一致趋势成立：随机划分验证mAP虚高（如GWHD v8n为80.0但测试仅61.5），而SASP+CDRO使验证更可靠且测试mAP提升（如GWHD v8n提升至68.0、v5x提升至72.0；VisDrone v10x从50.0提升至51.9；BCCD从85.6提升至89.2）；（4）验证-测试差距显著缩小，使早停机制正常工作；（5）置信度分布向高置信区域迁移（GWHD上>0.7置信度预测占比从8%升至53%）。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了空时相关领域中随机划分评估的根本缺陷，将数据集划分重新框定为结构化优化问题。SASP通过语义相似性强制结构不重叠并保持类别平衡，CDRO在严格划分下恢复训练稳定性。框架在三个领域均能纠正误导性评估并改善训练动力学与校准。其思想可推广至语言模型的数据污染与基准泄露问题，呼吁未来基准采用结构感知评估以确保报告的改进对应真实可靠性。

Abstract: Performance evaluation in AI systems commonly assumes that random dataset splits produce independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) subsets. We show that this assumption often breaks down in spatiotemporally correlated domains such as aerial surveillance, precision agriculture, and medical imaging, leading to two systematic failures: data leakage, where correlated samples span training and validation splits and inflate performance estimates, and hidden stratification, where errors on minority subpopulations are obscured by aggregate metrics. To address these issues, we propose a unified evaluation and training framework for spatially correlated data. We introduce Structure-Aware Stratified Partitioning (SASP), which constructs validation splits that reduce spatiotemporal leakage while preserving meaningful class balance, and Curriculum Distributionally Robust Optimization (CDRO), a curriculum-based relaxation of distributionally robust training that stabilizes optimization under these stricter splits. Across multiple benchmarks, this combination yields consistently improved generalization, more reliable confidence calibration, and exposes failure modes that remain hidden under conventional random-split evaluation.

### [83] [SA-HGNN: Sample-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Neural Network for EEG-Based Depression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02063)

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely used to capture spatial functional connectivity patterns to improve electroencephalography (EEG)-based depression recognition performance. However, the functional connectivity of brain networks in patients with depression exhibits an inherent hierarchical structure, making it difficult to capture accurate connection patterns. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel model named Sample-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Neural Network (SA-HGNN), which aims to accurately extract the authentic hierarchical structure of depression-affected brain networks. Specifically, the proposed model comprises three core modules. First, a Sample-Adaptive Graph Construction module dynamically constructs personalized brain network topologies to capture more complex spatial relationships within the brain network. Second, hyperbolic graph convolution is employed to overcome the representation bottlenecks of Euclidean space, leveraging hyperbolic geometry to precisely capture latent hierarchical relationships within the brain network. Finally, an Attention Pooling module adaptively filters out highly redundant noise channels in EEG signals, effectively mitigating the interference of inherent noise on the authentic hierarchical topology. Extensive experiments on public EEG datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method across resting-state and task-related paradigms, validating its robustness to noise and efficacy in capturing abnormal functional connectivity patterns in brain networks of patients with depression.

</details>


### [84] [kNNGuard: Turning LLM Hidden Activations into a Training-Free Configurable Guardrail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02072)
*Mahmoud Abdelfattah,Hamid Nasiri,Peter Garraghan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: kNNGuard是一种无需训练的LLM护栏框架，利用现成LLM的隐藏激活空间结合句子嵌入，通过多层kNN分类检测不安全、偏离主题或对抗性提示。在六个领域上以87.4%的平均F1和2.7倍速度优势超越主流微调护栏，且域适配仅需约10秒（比LoRA微调快约3156倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM护栏主要依赖微调分类器，存在泛化能力差、推理延迟高、域适配成本高等问题；轻量级嵌入kNN方法又因仅捕捉表层语义而难以处理细微安全/越狱/提示注入等攻击。研究动机在于：突破"训练分布即分类边界"的局限，利用LLM内部激活结构本身所蕴含的安全语义信息，构建一个无需梯度更新、低延迟、可即时适配的护栏系统。

Method: 方法包含两个阶段：(1) 银行构建——将少量标注样本（每类50个）通过冻结LLM，提取多层（均匀采样的9个Transformer层，含第0层和最后一层）最后一个token的隐藏激活，并用Fisher判别率计算每层的类间/类内比作为权重；同时用MiniLM句子编码器生成嵌入并缓存。(2) 推理——新提示同样提取激活与嵌入，通过余弦距离kNN（k=13）得到激活空间风险分数和嵌入空间风险分数；采用自适应置信度融合策略：若两分支置信度差距大于阈值γ=0.1则采用赢家通吃，否则按置信度加权融合，最终以τ=0.5为决策阈值。还可叠加可选的领域系统提示以调整激活几何。提出两个变体：kNNGuard LE（仅激活层集成）和kNNGuard FE（激活+嵌入融合）。

Result: 在六个领域（代码指令、代码输出、医疗、安全、越狱、提示注入）评测：(1) 平均F1达87.4%，FPR 12.9%，延迟45.9ms/提示，2.7×快于Llama Nemotron Topic Guard V1（126ms）、10×快于Nemotron Safety Guard V2（454.6ms），F1优于Llama Guard 3（74.2%）和Llama Nemotron Safety Guard V2（79.2%）；(2) 主题域F1高达95–99%，FPR≤0.9%；(3) 安全域保持最均衡的FPR/ASR权衡，而其他护栏至少在一个域极端失败（如Topic Guard V1在越狱FPR=97.4%，Prompt Guard 2在越狱ASR=50.2%）；(4) t-SNE显示激活空间Silhouette分数较嵌入空间提升53–89%；(5) 100样本银行构建仅7.95秒，较LoRA微调3156×加速；(6) 系统提示使FPR降低66%；(7) 跨6种LLM backbone均表现稳定（含abliterated模型）。

Conclusion: kNNGuard证明：LLM隐藏激活空间天然蕴含比句子嵌入更优的安全/主题可分性，可作为无需训练的非参数分类界面。在性能、延迟和适配成本三方面同时超越现有微调护栏，使得基于会话级、上下文专属的护栏配置成为可能。未来工作包括通过参考库更新或持续学习处理概念漂移与新兴攻击，结合可解释性研究提升准确度，并扩展到工具输出监控以保护agentic AI系统。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in domains requiring guardrails to detect unsafe, off-topic, or adversarial prompts. Existing guardrails predominately rely on fine-tuning to build classifiers, which often suffer from low generalization and high inference latency. We present kNNGuard, a training-free guardrail that utilizes the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM. Given a small bank of 50 safe and unsafe prompts, kNNGuard extracts hidden activations and performs multi-layer kNN fusing activation-space and embedding-space scores for classification. Across six domains spanning topical and security prompts, kNNGuard achieves competitive or superior F1 compared to fine-tuned state-of-the-art guardrails while running 2.7x faster than the best comparable guardrail, and 10x faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier without gradient updates or fine-tuning. Domain adaptation requires only updating the labeled bank, which can be constructed in under 10 seconds and several orders of magnitude faster than established guardrails. We also analyze the impact of system prompts, layer selection, and integration into production LLM pipelines as a configurable, low-latency guardrail.

</details>


### [85] [ART for Diffusion Sampling: Continuous-Time Control and Actor-Critic Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02137)
*Yilie Huang,Wenpin Tang,Xun Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ART（Adaptive Reparameterized Time）框架，将扩散模型采样中的时间步分配问题建模为连续时间最优控制问题，通过引入采样时钟的"速率"作为控制变量来学习自适应的非均匀时间网格。为解决高维HJB方程的维度灾难，进一步提出ART-RL辅助随机化问题（采用高斯策略），并证明了二者在最优性层面的等价性。基于连续时间强化学习的actor-critic理论，导出了可实现的策略评估与策略改进更新规则。实验覆盖一维解析得分、CIFAR-10（EDM管线）、MNIST（小模型）、AFHQv2、FFHQ、ImageNet-64及ImageNet-512（EDM2管线），ART-RL在所有场景下均一致优于Uniform、EDM和DPM基线时间表，且学得的时间表具有出色的迁移性，无需重训练即可跨时间步预算、数据集、求解器、管线和表征空间使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样阶段需要将学到的反向时间动力学离散化到有限时间网格上，时间步的选择直接决定了固定计算预算的使用方式及样本质量。现有的Uniform、EDM、DPM等时间表均为手工设计的固定方案，缺乏原则性的优化框架，存在以下不足：(1) 在不同任务上未必最优，例如EDM虽在图像生成上表现强劲，在简单一维解析得分问题上反而劣于Uniform网格；(2) 无法根据误差分布自适应地在反向轨迹的关键区域分配更多函数评估；(3) 时间表与特定任务耦合，迁移性差。本文旨在从控制理论角度构建一套原则性的时间步分配方法。

Method: 1. **ART（连续时间控制建模）**：引入重参数化采样时钟 $t$，通过连续映射 $\tau=\psi(t)$ 将其与物理扩散时间 $\tau$ 关联，控制变量 $\theta(t)=\dot\psi(t)$ 决定了物理时间的局部推进速率，受约束 $\int_0^T\theta(t)dt=T$；基于Euler离散化的二阶Taylor展开，定义局部误差代理 $|Q(x,\psi)|\theta^2$，由此构建控制目标泛函 $J^\theta$，将时间步分配转化为最大化该目标的最优控制问题。

2. **ART-RL（随机化辅助问题）**：采用方差依赖于局部刚度指标 $|Q|$ 的高斯策略 $\pi^{(\lambda)}(\cdot|t,x,\psi)=\mathcal{N}(\mu,\lambda/|Q|)$，通过引入连续时间强化学习框架解决HJB方程在高维下不可解的问题。证明核心定理：高斯策略最优均值与ART原问题的最优控制一致（$\mu^*=\theta^*$），且值函数满足 $V^{(\lambda)}=V+\lambda t$。

3. **Actor-Critic算法**：基于Jia-Zhou的连续时间actor-critic理论，建立策略评估（鞅正交性条件）和策略改进（Hamilton型最大化）的定理，通过随机逼近推导参数更新规则（梯度形式的TD误差），并加入Lagrange乘子 $\gamma$ 以保证终端约束 $\psi(T)=T$。最终将学到的随机策略蒸馏为确定性时间表，以便零推理开销部署。

Result: **一维解析得分实验**：K=2至100所有预算下，ART-RL的W2误差均最优（如K=100时0.013 vs EDM 0.023、DPM 0.027、Uniform 0.016），且对手工设计的EDM/DPM甚至不如Uniform。

**CIFAR-10（EDM管线，Heun采样）**：NFE=3至35所有预算下ART-RL均获最佳FID，最大预算NFE=35时FID为1.82（EDM 1.85、DPM 1.89），低预算优势尤其显著（NFE=5时130.48 vs EDM 305.15）。

**CIFAR-10（Euler采样）**：NFE=2至80所有预算下ART-RL均最优，NFE=80时FID 2.28 vs EDM 2.50。

**MNIST小模型（RK4求解器）**：LeNet-FID在所有NFE下最优，NFE=25时1.09 vs EDM 1.23，验证了在小模型上的有效性。

**跨时间步迁移**：在CIFAR-10上K=18学到的调度，通过对数线性插值/外推可直接用于K'∈{4,6,9,12,15,20}，FID全面优于EDM和DPM。

**跨数据集迁移**：CIFAR-10学到的调度零重训练迁移到AFHQv2、FFHQ、ImageNet-64（像素空间EDM管线），FID均最低。

**跨管线迁移（EDM2）**：在ImageNet-512潜在空间EDM2管线（XS模型）上仍优于EDM和DPM，FID和IS双指标全面领先，是最强迁移验证。

Conclusion: 本文提出了首个基于控制理论的扩散模型时间步分配框架，将启发式网格替换为原则性的、数据驱动的学习方案。核心贡献在于建立了ART确定性控制问题与ART-RL随机化强化学习问题之间的最优性等价关系，使得高维问题可借助成熟的连续时间actor-critic理论求解。ART-RL的优势体现在三个方面：(1) 普遍性——跨任务、跨求解器（Euler/Heun/RK4）一致优于手工设计调度；(2) 可重用性——一次学习、蒸馏后即作为即插即用时间表，推理开销与EDM/DPM相同；(3) 强迁移性——无需重训练即可跨数据集、管线、表征空间使用，证明了其学到的是可泛化的结构而非数据集特定过拟合。未来可探索方向包括：拓展至SDE采样器、设计与高阶积分器对齐的误差代理、研究状态依赖调度的潜在优势。

Abstract: We study timestep allocation for score-based diffusion sampling, where a learned reverse-time dynamics is discretized on a finite grid. Uniform and hand-crafted schedules are standard choices, but they rely on fixed prescriptions and can therefore be suboptimal. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Reparameterized Time (ART), a continuous-time control formulation that learns a time change by treating the speed of the sampling clock as the control, so that a uniform grid on the learned clock induces adaptive timesteps in the original diffusion time. Based on a leading-order Euler error surrogate, ART provides a principled objective for allocating timesteps along the sampling trajectory. To solve this deterministic control problem, we introduce ART-RL, an auxiliary randomized formulation with Gaussian policies that turns schedule learning into a continuous-time reinforcement learning problem. We prove that the randomized ART-RL formulation is equivalent to ART at the optimizer level, in the sense that its optimal Gaussian policy recovers the optimal ART time-warping rate through its mean. We further establish policy evaluation and policy improvement characterizations and derive trajectory-based moment identities that yield implementable actor--critic updates for learning the schedule. Across experiments ranging from controlled low-dimensional settings to image generation, ART-RL can be plugged into existing diffusion samplers by changing only the timestep grid, consistently improving sample quality over strong baseline schedules at matched budgets while leaving the rest of the sampling pipeline unchanged. The learned schedules also exhibit broad generalization, transferring without retraining across sampling budgets, datasets, solvers, pipelines, and representation spaces.

</details>


### [86] [Predicting Early Stages Of Alzheimer's Disease And Identifying Key Biomarkers Using Deep Artificial Neural Network And Ensemble Of Machine Learning Methodologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02142)
*Debopriya Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的阿尔茨海默病（AD）早期检测方法，结合临床数据、神经心理学测试评分和神经影像学特征，使用堆叠集成模型和人工神经网络进行分类，旨在筛选最佳分类器并识别关键生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病早期症状轻微易与正常衰老混淆，导致诊断延迟。虽然目前无法完全治愈，但早期检测有助于医生及时干预。因此，迫切需要利用机器学习技术从多模态数据中实现AD早期精准诊断。

Method: 1. 数据来源：使用ADNI数据集，整合临床信息、神经心理学测试评分和神经影像学特征。2. 数据预处理：采用迭代填充法（Iterative Imputation）处理缺失值；使用Borderline SVM-SMOTE解决类别不平衡问题。3. 特征选择：结合包装法（Wrapper-based）和嵌入法（Embedded methods）筛选重要特征。4. 模型构建：构建堆叠集成（Stacking）模型，以逻辑回归、Extra Trees、Bagging KNN和LightGBM作为基分类器；同时训练人工神经网络（ANN）。5. 评估指标：采用精确率、召回率、F1分数和AUC-ROC进行模型性能对比。

Result: 由于原文仅提供摘要，未给出具体的实验数值结果。但研究通过对比堆叠集成模型与人工神经网络的性能，目标在于确定最优分类器，并识别出有助于AD早期诊断的重要生物标志物。

Conclusion: 该研究通过多阶段数据处理（缺失值填充、不平衡处理、特征选择）和集成学习策略，有望提升AD早期检测的准确性，为临床医生提供辅助诊断工具，同时挖掘具有临床价值的生物标志物。（具体结论需结合完整论文实验结果进一步验证。）

Abstract: Alzheimers disease (AD) is a brain disorder that develops slowly and mainly affects memory, thinking, language, and daily activities. It is one of the most common causes of dementia and creates many difficulties for patients as well as their families. In the early stage, the symptoms are often mild and may look like normal ageing. For this reason, many people are diagnosed late, when the disease has already progressed. At present, there is no complete cure for AD. Still, early detection can help doctors manage the condition better and take suitable steps at the right time. In this study, a machine learning model is proposed to detect the early stages of Alzheimers disease using clinical details, neuropsychological test scores, and neuroimaging-related measures. The data used in this work is collected from the Alzheimers Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). As the dataset has missing values, iterative imputation is applied to fill them. The dataset also has class imbalance, which is handled using Borderline SVM-SMOTE. After that, feature selection is carried out using wrapper-based and embedded methods so that only important features are used for training. The selected features are divided into training and testing sets, and feature scaling is applied. A stacking ensemble model is developed using Logistic Regression, Extra Trees, Bagging KNN, and LightGBM as base classifiers. Along with this, an artificial neural network is also trained on the same dataset. The performance of these models is compared using precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC. This study aims to find the best classifier and also identify important biomarkers that may help in the early diagnosis of Alzheimers disease.

</details>


### [87] [Dynamic Neural Graph Encoding of Inference Processes in Deep Weight Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02166)
*Di Wu,Huan Liu,Zhixiang Chi,Yuanhao Yu,Konstantinos N. Plataniotis,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出动态神经图(Dynamic Neural Graph)概念,将神经网络参数建模为随时间演化的动态图,并设计基于RNN的图编码器DNG-Encoder,通过保留逐层前向传播的时序特性来避免静态图固有的"逆问题"。进一步提出INR2JLS框架,将INR权重映射到权重与原始图像的联合潜空间,在INR分类、CNN泛化预测等任务上取得显著优于现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度权重空间学习方法存在两大局限:(1)受限训练方法忽视置换对称性,增加了最优参数搜索空间;(2)基于静态神经图(如NG-GNN、NG-T)的GNN方法忽视了神经网络推理的逐层时序特性,导致"逆问题"——在深层消息传递时,偏置b与加权的偏置W·b会混合在一起,使后续层需要从不完备的复合值中恢复原始偏置,本质上是病态不适定问题。此外,置换等变方法(NFN、NFT)需要针对固定架构手工适配,无法处理异构网络。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件:(1)动态神经图构造——将L层MLP建模为动态图G_T=(G_t0, O_[t1:tL]),在每个时间戳tl执行图更新事件(节点增删、边增删),使得每一时刻的快照G_tl仅包含当前前向传播涉及的相邻层节点,严格模拟逐层计算拓扑;CNN通过将卷积核的每个标量作为独立边,并使用padding保证节点对之间边数一致。(2)DNG-Encoder——基于FiLM的线性条件缩放机制定义消息函数(单边MLP对应,多边用多头机制聚合),采用GRU+LayerNorm更新节点记忆,实现RNN式的逐层时序处理,彻底避免静态图中的逆问题。(3)INR2JLS——编码器(DNG-Encoder+潜空间生成器)将INR权重映射到联合潜空间,通过转置卷积解码器直接重建原始图像而非INR权重,结合旋转/翻转数据增强生成F_aug特征图用于下游分类。理论证明动态图与DNG-Encoder均具有置换等变性。

Result: 在INR分类任务(表1)上:INR2JLS在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上分别超越最佳基线9%和10%,达到73.2%和42.4%的准确率,参数量仅约6M;在CNN泛化预测任务(表2)上,CIFAR-10-GS的Kendall's τ达0.936,CNN Wild Park异构数据集达0.8743,显著优于NG-GNN(0.804)和NG-T(0.817);效率分析(表5)显示推理速度最快(0.0047秒),计算复杂度最低(1.31 GFLOPs);Transformer泛化预测任务(表8)上τ达0.9028,延迟仅4.38ms。消融研究证实:动态图架构本身相对静态图带来显著提升(CIFAR-10上+9.31%),旋转翻转增强在CIFAR-10/100上分别带来约7%/9%提升,联合潜空间优于INR权重重建(IRN-INR),DNG-Encoder+Latent Generator+Decoder组合各模块均不可缺。

Conclusion: 本文成功将神经网络前向传播的时序特性融入图表示学习,证明了动态图在深度权重空间建模中的本质优势。INR2JLS通过引入权重-图像联合潜空间,提供了更具判别力的特征表示,且框架架构无关,可处理MLP、CNN、Transformer等异构网络。局限性包括:(1)INR分类性能仍低于直接在图像空间训练的CNN;(2)对于权重编辑、生成类任务,静态图或token化模型可能更合适;(3)存在双重用途风险,需配套研究权重混淆与水印防御机制;未来工作包括设计更强的时序GNN变体、扩展动态图以支持边重建等生成任务。

Abstract: The rapid advancements in using neural networks as implicit data representations have attracted significant interest in developing machine learning methods that analyze and process the weight spaces of other neural networks. However, efficiently handling these highdimensional weight spaces remains challenging. Existing methods often overlook the sequential nature of layer-by-layer processing in neural network inference. In this work, we propose a novel approach using dynamic graphs to represent neural network parameters, capturing the temporal dynamics of inference. Our Dynamic Neural Graph Encoder (DNG-Encoder) processes these graphs, preserving the sequential nature of neural processing. Additionally, we also leverage DNG-Encoder to develop INR2JLS (Implicit Neural Representation to Joint Latent Space) for facilitate downstream applications, such as classifying Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). Our approach demonstrates significant improvements across multiple tasks, surpassing the state-of-the-art INR classification accuracy by approximately 10% on the CIFAR-100-INR.

</details>


### [88] [HERMES: A Multi-Granularity Labeling Substrate for Pre-training Data Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02266)
*Ziyun Qiao,Yue Min,Ruining Chen,Yujun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HERMES 提出了一种数据驱动的多粒度标注框架，通过 Learned Semantic Transform 与 3 级残差矢量量化（RVQ）将每个文档一次性标注为粗到细的层级编码，前缀长度控制粒度（最大约 130k 个单元）。其核心贡献是"基底"而非聚类算法本身——在 L1=256 粒度上与 KMeans 系列方法持平，但在 1B/25B 预训练中揭示了固定粒度管线无法测试的粒度与 Stage-2 采样器的交互效应：在 L12 处质量前 30% 采样比最大熵覆盖提升 +0.0253 Avg，但该优势在 L123 处因候选池缩小 5.3× 而消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据混合方法依赖预先划分好的语料分组（来源/主题/格式分类法或平面嵌入聚类），这些标签系统只能锁定单一语义轴和单一粒度；若想改变分辨率则必须重建标签。作者认为瓶颈在标签系统而不在混合器，需要一个可复用的、可调粒度的层次化标签基底。

Method: HERMES 由两部分组成：(1) Learned Semantic Transform (LST)——单层线性+normalize，将冻结的 1024 维文档嵌入旋转至适合量化的几何空间，使用结构保持、重建与正交三项损失联合训练；(2) 3 级残差矢量量化 (RVQ)——对变换后向量逐级取余量最大值编码，K=256，L=3，输出层级码 (c1,c2,c3)；前缀长度 l=1,2,3 分别对应 256/~65k/~130k 桶。采样分两阶段：Stage-1 为 L1 外层权重（Uniform 或 DoReMi），Stage-2 为子桶内规则（最大熵覆盖 vs 质量前 30%）。在 1B 模型、25B token、内部约 50M 文档语料上训练，按 16 任务能力族等权宏平均 Avg. 评测。

Result: 三项主要结果：(1) 在 L1=256 上，五种聚类方法（KMeans、MiniBatchKMeans、BisectingKMeans、Plain RVQ、HERMES）在聚类内禀指标上处于平台期；HERMES 与 KMeans 在下游几乎持平（Δ=0.0002 Avg）；(2) Finding A：在固定 DoReMi-L1 外权重与 L12 粒度下，把 Stage-2 从最大熵覆盖改为（修正读取器的）质量前 30% 提升 Avg. +0.0253（z +2.09）；(3) Finding B：同一 Stage-2 优势在 L123 处消失（0.3988 vs 0.3986），与候选池中位数从 2271 缩至 429 文档（5.3×）的候选竞争机制一致。1B/25B 共有 14+6 个排名检查点，最高分配置为 HERMES + DoReMi-L1 + L12 质量前 30%（Avg. 0.4222）。

Conclusion: HERMES 将数据混合设计从"在固定标签集中选择"重新定义为"在可复用的数据派生粒度层级上导航"：粒度与 Stage-2 采样器是在基底上联合决定的两个轴，而非独立超参。该工作承认存在诸多局限（1B/25B 单一语料、单编码器、单 seed、DoReMi 外权重在 L12 质量前 30% 下 Uniform 对照未跑、第三阶段码本更深层级与候选竞争下界关系未系统扫描等）。未来方向包括更深或更宽的 RVQ 层级、跨粒度联合学习外权重、使用 RVQ 重建误差等内禀信号替代外部质量评分进行软子桶选择。

Abstract: Most data-mixing methods assume the corpus has already been partitioned into groups, and the choice of those groups determines what a mixer can express. Existing labels, including provenance, topic or format taxonomies, and flat embedding clusters, commit to one semantic axis at one granularity; changing the resolution rebuilds the labels. We argue the bottleneck is the label system, not the mixer, and provide a hierarchical one. HERMES is a data-derived labeling substrate: a Learned Semantic Transform followed by 3-stage residual vector quantization annotates each document once into a coarse-to-fine code whose prefix length controls granularity up to approximately 130k cells. At coarse granularity HERMES sits at a plateau with KMeans-family methods on standard clustering metrics, so the contribution is the substrate, not the clusterer. On 1B-parameter, 25B-token pre-training, the hierarchy exposes an interaction fixed-granularity pipelines cannot test: at one prefix length, a combined Stage-2 rule contrast, equal-subbucket coverage versus size-proportional within-bucket quality top-30%, lifts a 16-task capability macro-average by +0.0253; at the next finer level, the same rule loses its measurable edge as candidate pools contract approximately 5x. HERMES reframes data mixture design from choosing among fixed label sets to navigating a reusable, data-derived granularity hierarchy.

</details>


### [89] [Generalization in offline RL: The structure is more important than the amount of pessimism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02288)
*Max Weltevrede,Matthijs T.J. Spaan,Wendelin Böhmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了离线强化学习中"过度保守会阻碍泛化"的传统观点，提出关键在于悲观主义的**结构**（是否尊重最优解的对称性）而非其**程度**。在上下文MDP的零样本策略迁移（ZSPT）设定下，理论证明只要悲观值函数保持对称性，即使悲观程度任意大仍可最优泛化；反之，轻微但破坏对称性的悲观可能导致任意差的泛化。实验表明，数据增强应以一致性损失（而非扩充训练集）形式应用于策略提取阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL为避免对分布外动作的过估计偏差，通常采用悲观值学习。但近期工作认为过度保守会阻碍泛化（如轨迹拼接、跨环境迁移），并提出应尽量降低保守程度。然而，这种"保守程度越低越好"的观点在新环境/任务的零样本迁移中是否成立尚不清楚。本文旨在厘清悲观程度与泛化性能之间的真实关系。

Method: 1. **理论框架**：在GTI-ZSPT（Generalization Through Invariance ZSPT）设定下分析——训练时仅接触子群B≤G的样本，测试时需对完整对称群G保持不变性。\n2. **定理1**（对称悲观的有益性）：利用NTK无限宽度极限与Gerken & Kessel (2024)的等变边界，证明若悲观值目标Q*_sym满足子群B的对称性，只要最优与次优动作的间隔δ_Q超过与η_max无关的阈值C_Θ(ε)，即可保证测试CMDP上的最优性，且η_max可任意大。\n3. **定理2**（对称性破坏的危害）：构造一类反例GTI-ZSPT实例Z，其非对称悲观目标Q*_asym在测试时产生任意大的最优性间隙。说明"较不悲观"不等于"泛化更好"。\n4. **实验验证**：在旋转对称Reacher环境（C4训练，SO(2)测试）上比较CQL/IQL下四种DA方法：(a) Aug-D 训练时拼接增强数据；(b) Aug-D-Online仅增强Actor输入；(c) DAC-Latent 在隐层加一致性损失；(d) DAC-Output 在输出层加一致性损失。

Result: **理论结果**：Q值蒸馏实验中，Q*_sym在η_max从0.01增至10的过程中测试回报从0.76提升至0.99并保持稳定；而Q*_asym在η_max=0.01时测试表现0.76，随η_max增大反而下降至0.23（η_max=10），验证了定理1和2。\n**离线RL实验**（IQL，混合数据集）：No DA=0.34；Aug-D=0.68；Aug-D-Online=0.71；DAC-Latent=0.67；**DAC-Output=0.96**。在Expert和Suboptimal数据集中DAC-Output同样最优。CQL上呈现类似模式。实验还表明：(i) 对称性比精度更重要；(ii) 将DA应用于Actor效果优于或等同于应用于Critic或两者。

Conclusion: 本文从理论与实证两方面论证：离线RL泛化的关键不在于悲观主义的程度，而在于其结构是否尊重最优解的对称性。这一发现将研究焦点从"减少保守"转向"保持结构对称"。实践上，提出数据增强应以一致性损失（尤其输出级DAC-Output）形式施加于策略提取阶段，而非简单扩充训练集，从而在offline RL中有效提升零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: While pessimism counteracts overestimation bias in offline reinforcement learning (RL), being overly conservative has been associated with hindering certain forms of generalization. However, in this paper we demonstrate that being overly pessimistic does not inherently prevent optimal generalization in contextual MDPs (CMDPs). Instead, we argue successful generalization depends not on the amount of pessimism, but whether the pessimistic structure respects the underlying symmetries of the optimal solution. We prove that a mildly pessimistic, non-symmetric value function can generalize worse than an overly pessimistic, symmetric one. In offline RL, the structure of the pessimism is determined by the structure of the dataset coverage. As such, enforcing a symmetric value function can be non-trivial, and might require techniques such as data augmentation (DA). Inspired by our theoretical results, we argue that DA can best be applied through a consistency loss during policy extraction, rather than the common practice of (regular) offline training on an augmented dataset. This is empirically validated using IQL and CQL on a rotationally symmetric reacher environment.

</details>


### [90] [Self-Gating Attention for Efficient Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02344)
*Dezheng Wang,Tong Chen,Wei Yuan,Congyan Chen,Shihua Li,Hongzhi Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于时间序列预测的高效注意力机制——自门控注意力（SGA）。SGA通过共享可学习矩阵与输入依赖残差分量重新参数化注意力分数，去除了标准自注意力中的Query和Key投影，在保持预测性能的同时实现了关于回看长度的线性时间与内存复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer自注意力机制的时间和内存复杂度为关于回看长度的平方级O(L²)，难以部署在资源受限或高吞吐量的预测系统中。作者通过定性与定量分析发现，时间序列预测中不同时间戳的自注意力图谱存在显著的冗余模式（ETTm1数据集上各注意力头之间的余弦相似度高达0.885–0.975），且初步实验表明仅用共享注意力分数矩阵即可达到接近标准自注意力的性能。这表明时间序列中重复的时间模式与稳定的时间相关性导致重复的query-key计算存在冗余。

Method: SGA将注意力分数矩阵重新参数化为S_t = ψ(A, R_t)，其中A是跨时间戳共享的可学习注意力分数矩阵（捕捉共性模式），R_t是基于输入值归一化二阶统计量（能量）构建的输入依赖残差分数矩阵（捕捉局部变化）。具体而言：1）对每个头使用正交初始化的共享矩阵A；2）残差分支通过softplus缩放的归一化能量、可学习偏置和低秩双线性项构建；3）融合前对A和R_t分别进行行级Top-K稀疏化，再各自softmax后相加；4）去除了query和key投影，仅保留value投影，将复杂度从O(L²)降至O(L)。该方法可推广至交叉注意力场景，并支持多头机制。

Result: 在9个公开数据集（涵盖电力、金融、天气、医疗监测、人类活动与气候记录）和8个主流预测骨干（TimeXer、iTransformer、SimpleTM、CARD、FEDformer、PAttn、MultiPatchFormer、t-PatchGNN）上的全面实验表明：1）SGA在90个评估设置中取得84个最佳或次佳结果，平均排名1.000，Nemenyi检验显示显著优于ProbSparse、AutoCorrelation和SA；2）在TimeXer骨干上，SGA相比标准SA减少超过60%的FLOPs和参数量；3）训练速度提升约1.19倍，推理速度提升约1.25倍；4）消融实验验证了共享矩阵、残差分支、Top-K稀疏化和正交初始化的各自贡献；5）对超参数（Top-K比例、dropout率）和不同回看长度与注意力头数均表现出良好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SGA通过共享注意力分数矩阵与输入依赖残差分数的协同设计，有效捕捉了时间序列预测中的共性模式与局部变化，以线性复杂度替代了标准自注意力的平方级计算开销，同时在多种骨干网络和预测任务上保持了竞争力的预测精度。作为一种即插即用的注意力模块，SGA在准确性与效率之间取得了良好平衡，可服务于资源受限的工业部署场景。当前结果基于公开基准与高端GPU平台，扩展到完整工业预测系统与更广泛的实际应用场景是未来工作的方向。

Abstract: Transformer architectures have shown strong potential in time series forecasting, where multi-head self-attention is widely used to capture temporal dependencies across historical timestamps. However, standard self-attention has quadratic time and memory complexity with respect to the look-back length. This cost may limit its use in resource-constrained or high-throughput forecasting systems, where fast and memory-efficient inference is important. Through qualitative and quantitative analyses, we observe that self-attention maps in time series forecasting often contain redundant patterns across different timestamps. This phenomenon can be related to the repeated temporal patterns and relatively stable temporal correlations in many real-world time series. Motivated by this observation, we propose Self-Gating Attention (SGA), a plug-and-play attention mechanism that represents the attention score with a shared learnable matrix and an input-dependent residual component. The shared matrix captures common attention patterns, while the residual component captures input-dependent variations. In this way, SGA avoids the query and key projections used in standard attention score computation, leading to linear time and score-matrix memory complexity with respect to the look-back length. We integrate SGA into several forecasting backbones and compare it with standard self-attention and lightweight attention variants on nine publicly available real-world datasets covering electricity, finance, weather, medical monitoring, human activity, and climate records. The results show that SGA improves inference efficiency on public benchmarks while maintaining competitive forecasting performance against state-of-the-art attention mechanisms. These benchmark results provide deployment-oriented evidence.

</details>


### [91] [Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02423)
*Zhuowei Chen,Liwei Chen,Christian Schunn,Raquel Coelho,Xiang Lorraine Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuFS，一种面向 LLM 的神经元感知主动少样本学习框架。该方法将样本选择信号从传统的输出级代理（如预测熵、外部嵌入语义相似度）转向模型的内部神经元激活模式，通过双准则选择策略同时实现多样性与幻觉抑制，在推理和分类任务上一致优于现有 AFSL 基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动少样本学习（AFSL）方法主要依赖输出级信号进行样本选择，例如基于外部嵌入的语义相似度或基于输出 logits 的预测熵。但存在两个核心问题：（1）LLM 在置信度上存在过度自信与幻觉现象，token 级预测熵与知识评估存在目标错位，无法准确反映模型的内在知识状态；（2）"语义相似即知识相似"的强假设不成立——语义相似的样本可能激发完全不同的知识电路。作者受近期神经元分析研究启发，发现 FFN 中的神经元激活模式与具体知识概念及幻觉现象存在关联，从而提出利用模型内部动力学替代外部代理信号。

Method: NeuFS 框架包含三个阶段：（1）**神经元激活识别**：从 LLM 所有 Transformer 层的 FFN 中提取激活值，通过"早期反嵌入"（Early Unembedding）将每个神经元投影到输出词表空间，计算其对预测 token 的贡献分数 S，筛选出 top-k 高贡献神经元作为有效激活集 N_act；（2）**神经元感知样本多样化**：以稀疏激活神经元集合作为样本表示，利用 Jaccard 距离度量样本间相似性，通过 K-Medoids 聚类（C 个簇对应 shot 数）保证知识覆盖多样性；（3）**神经元共识量化**：将独特激活神经元的数量 |N_act| 定义为共识度量 Q(x)，较低共识意味着更多独特电路被激发、模型更易幻觉，因此优先选择低共识样本。双准则得分 Score(x) = τ·Q̃(x) + (1-τ)·D̃_J(x, μ_i)，从每个簇中选取得分最高的样本进行人工标注。

Result: 在 MMLU-Pro（推理）、Edu-Feedback 和 TREC（分类）三个数据集上，使用 Llama-3.1-8B/3.2-3B 和 Qwen3-8B/4B 四个模型，在 5/10/20/30 shot 设置下进行评估。关键发现：（1）NeuFS 在所有模型和数据集上一致取得第 1 或第 2 名，例如 Qwen3-4B 上 MMLU-Pro 准确率达 0.452，超过 TypiClust (0.437) 和 Patron (0.391)；（2）消融实验中，神经元激活信号优于 SimCSE 和 Qwen-Embedding 等密集向量表示；（3）统计分析证实预测错误样本激活的神经元数量显著多于正确预测样本（t=-3.57, p<0.001），且低共识示范样本与更好的推理性能呈正相关（Pearson r=0.67, p<0.001）；（4）超参数 τ 在 8B 模型上 τ=0.5 最佳，在 4B 模型上纯多样性（τ=0）更优，表明小模型内部信号噪声更大。

Conclusion: NeuFS 验证了内部神经元激活作为少样本选择信号的优越性，相比输出级不确定性或外部语义嵌入，能更直接揭示 LLM 的知识电路与幻觉倾向，提供更具原则性的选择策略。工作局限在于需要访问 FFN 激活和反嵌入矩阵，限制了对黑盒 API 模型的适用性，且在大规模无标注池上分析神经元模式带来额外计算开销。该工作强调了模型内部动力学在数据选择中的关键作用，为未来设计更稳健、有理论依据的选择策略提供了新方向。

Abstract: Active Few-Shot Learning (AFSL) adapts LLMs to specialized domains by identifying the most valuable unlabeled samples for annotation and use as few-shot demonstrations, effectively reducing human annotation costs while promoting high performance. However, existing methods typically rely on output-level signals for sample identification, such as predictive entropy or semantic similarities with test-time data based on external embeddings, which often overlook models' internal dynamics, which could pinpoint specific knowledge gaps. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuFS, a Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning framework that shifts the selection paradigm from output-level proxies to models' internal dynamics. NeuFS utilizes neuron activation patterns to represent sample directly, and includes a dual-criteria selection strategy that: (1) ensures few-shot sample diversity with neuron patterns for broader example coverage, while (2) prioritizing on identifying informative and challenging few-shot samples LLMs tend to hallucinate by quantifying neuron consensus. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that NeuFS excels in both reasoning and text classification tasks, outperforming existing AFSL baselines. Ablation studies further highlight that internal neuron activations provide a more principled and effective selection signal than external embeddings, validating the superiority of the proposed NeuFS.

</details>


### [92] [QFedAgent: Quantum-Enhanced Personalized Federated Learning for Multi-Agent Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02426)
*Quoc Bao Phan,Tuy Tan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QFedAgent提出了一种量子-经典混合的个性化联邦学习框架,用于多智能体活动识别。通过变分量子电路(VQC)融合加速度计与陀螺仪的多模态数据,仅用72个量子旋转参数即可替代传统MLP融合模块(33K参数),在OPPORTUNITY数据集上达到97.7%的平均测试准确率,验证了参数高效的量子融合在非IID联邦学习场景下的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体机器人系统产生异构、非独立同分布(non-IID)的多模态传感器流,传统联邦学习算法(如FedAvg)在客户端数据分布差异大时性能下降;而经典多模态融合方法(注意力、门控、Transformer等)参数量大,导致通信开销高,难以在资源受限的分布式场景中部署。因此需要一种既参数高效又能建模跨模态复杂关联的融合机制。

Method: 1) 架构设计:双CNN编码器分别处理加速度计和陀螺仪信号,生成模态嵌入;采用N=8量子比特、L=3层StronglyEntanglingLayers的VQC融合层,加速度计和陀螺仪嵌入分别通过RX旋转编码到q0-q3和q4-q7,利用量子纠缠建模跨模态交互,Pauli-Z测量得到融合表示;2) 个性化联邦训练:全局参数(CNN编码器、VQC旋转参数、投影权重)通过加权FedAvg聚合,客户端特定的适配器(adapter)和分类头保持本地私有;3) VQC使用参数移位规则(parameter-shift rule)计算梯度,与经典反向传播兼容。

Result: 在OPPORTUNITY数据集(4个被试作为4个客户端,形成subject-based non-IID划分)上,QFedAgent取得97.7%的平均测试准确率,优于Local-only(96.3%)、FedAvg(96.6%)、FedProx(96.7%)和MLP-FL(97.2%);VQC融合仅用72个旋转参数(总融合模块3,144参数含W_pre和W_post),相对MLP的33K参数实现约10倍缩减;最终训练损失最低(0.186 vs MLP-FL的0.193);消融实验显示N=8、L=3为最优配置,继续增大收益递减。但经典模拟下单轮训练时间为121.4秒,远高于经典方法的9.8-12.5秒。

Conclusion: QFedAgent证明了参数高效的量子融合在个性化联邦学习框架中能够有效建模多模态IMU数据,实现约10倍的参数压缩同时取得最优准确率,平衡了全局知识迁移与本地个性化适应。在真实量子硬件上,电路执行时间与参数数量无关,有望显著降低当前的模拟开销,为分布式机器人感知系统提供了一条有前景的技术路径。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive robotic sensing applications. However, multi-agent systems generate heterogeneous and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) multimodal sensor streams that degrade conventional FL algorithms, while classical fusion modules introduce substantial parameter overhead and communication cost. This paper proposes QFedAgent, a hybrid quantum-classical personalized FL framework for multi-agent activity recognition. The approach integrates a variational quantum circuit fusion module that models accelerometer--gyroscope interactions through quantum state encoding and entanglement, requiring only 72 quantum rotation parameters versus 33K in classical multi-layer perceptron-based fusion, achieving approximately 10x total parameter reduction. Experiments on the OPPORTUNITY dataset under subject-based non-IID partitions demonstrate 97.7% mean test accuracy, confirming that parameter-efficient quantum fusion remains competitive with conventional federated baselines.

</details>


### [93] [Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02460)
*Zhuowei Chen,Xiang Lorraine Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Neuron-OPSD，一种无需标注的 LLM 自我蒸馏框架，通过利用模型内部神经元激活信号来指导训练数据选择和教师上下文构建，结合 On-Policy Distillation（OPD）实现无监督自训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在专业领域（如教育、法律、STEM）中，专家标注成本高昂，亟需无标注的 LLM 自训练方法。然而现有自演化方法存在明显缺陷：基于 SFT 和 GRPO 的方法会导致域外性能退化，而基于奖励的 on-policy RL 会膨胀校准误差。关键挑战在于：当模型作为自身教师时，若不进行严格的数据选择，容易强化其原有的错误校准、虚假推理和幻觉。

Method: 提出 Neuron-OPSD 框架，包含两个核心机制：(1) **Neuron Consensus**（神经元一致性）：通过测量激活神经元数量 s(x)=|N(x)| 来评估样本可靠性，激活数量少表示模型对自身答案更确定，可作为无标签的幻觉检测代理；(2) **Neuron Overlap**（神经元重叠）：利用 Jaccard 距离度量样本间激活模式的相似度，为每个查询检索推理路径最相似的 K-shot 演示作为教师上下文。训练阶段采用 On-Policy Distillation，学生模型为零样本策略，教师为 EMA 更新的同模型条件于神经元重叠检索的上下文，通过最小化反向 KL 散度进行训练。

Result: 在 SciKnowEval（4个科学领域）、Edu-Feedback 和 MMLU-Pro 三个数据集上，基于 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 模型的实验显示：Neuron-OPSD 在多数源域（Mat、Phys、Edu）取得与 TTRL 相当或更优的域内增益（最高 +2.93），同时在跨域泛化和校准保持方面显著优于 LMSI、TTRL 和 Intuitor 基线，平均 ECE 几乎不增加（+0.003 vs TTRL 的 +0.009）。分析表明，性能增益与教师-学生间的 token 级熵差（ΔH）密切相关：Mat 和 Phys 域 ΔH 显著为负（-0.017、-0.010），恰好对应最大域内增益。但 Chem 和 Bio 域因教师无法提供 token 级锐化，增益有限。

Conclusion: Neuron-OPSD 是一种以数据为中心的无标注自蒸馏框架，通过神经元一致性选择可靠样本、通过神经元重叠构建有效教师上下文，在保持跨域泛化和校准的同时实现有竞争力的自改进增益。但存在局限：激活数量单独作为选择标准并不充分，需结合学习效用与可靠性平衡；神经元 Jaccard 检索在推理模式同质化的领域区分度有限；目前仅在 4B 模型上验证，更大模型的可扩展性有待研究。

Abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) without real-world interaction feedback or human-labeled supervision remains challenging, particularly in specialized domains where expert annotations are costly to obtain. Recent annotation-free self-evolution methods address this by using the model's own outputs as supervision signals, constructing a teacher via additional context and aggregating predictions across multiple rollouts through majority voting to produce pseudo-labels. However, these approaches are not without drawbacks: SFT- and GRPO-based variants suffer out-of-domain performance degradation, while reward-based on-policy RL inflates calibration error. In this paper, we propose Neuron On-Policy Self-Distillation (Neuron-OPSD), a data-centric framework for annotation-free self-distillation that leverages internal neuron activations to guide both training-data selection and teacher context construction. The model is then trained via on-policy distillation from the teacher distribution, requiring no ground-truth labels at any stage. Across specialized-domain benchmarks, Neuron-OPSD improves in-domain task performance while preserving cross-domain generalization and mitigating calibration collapse over prior annotation-free baselines. This framework is particularly relevant to settings where online interaction or external supervision is costly or infeasible, and is conceptually distinct from offline RL approaches that rely on logged, reward-labeled trajectories.

</details>


### [94] [Beyond Adam: SOAP and Muon for Faster, Label-Efficient Training of Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02499)
*Gil Harari,Yoel Zimmermann,Ola Tangen Kulseng,Laura Zichi,Chuin Wei Tan,Marc L. Descoteaux,Boris Kozinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了矩阵结构化优化器（Muon、SOAP、SOAP-Muon）与AdamW在训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）中的表现，发现在NequIP和Allegro两种等变图神经网络架构上，SOAP和SOAP-Muon在收敛速度和最终精度上均显著优于AdamW，尤其在稀疏力监督场景下优势更为突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLIP领域在网络架构和数据集方面投入巨大，但优化器选择长期被忽视，社区普遍默认使用Adam及其变体。鉴于LLM领域矩阵结构化优化器（如Shampoo、Muon、SOAP）已展现出超越Adam的潜力，作者旨在探索这些优化器在MLIP训练中的适用性，验证优化器选择是否是一个被低估但具有高影响力的设计维度。

Method: 在nequip框架中集成Muon、SOAP和SOAP-Muon三种优化器，并在两个具有物理意义的系统上进行基准测试：液态水（使用NequIP）和固体酸电解质CsH₂PO₄（CDP，使用Allegro）。研究采用系统化的超参数调优协议，考察不同力监督比例（100%、75%、50%、10%、5%、0%即纯能量训练）下的优化器表现。评估指标包括能量和力的MAE、训练墙钟时间，以及通过MD模拟验证物理保真度（RDFs、MSD、扩散激活能等）。

Result: 在全监督下，SOAP在CDP上将能量MAE降低9%，SOAP-Muon将力MAE降低14%；在water上将能量MAE降低24%，力MAE降低19%。SOAP达到AdamW精度水平的墙钟时间加速比达4.9×–5.8×。在稀疏力监督下，SOAP-Muon仅用50%力标签即可达到AdamW使用100%力标签的精度水平。在5%力标签的极低监督下，AdamW模型变得不稳定，而SOAP-Muon仍能保持稳定并准确复现AIMD结果，预测的质子扩散激活能（0.42 eV）与实验值（0.39–0.43 eV）高度一致。Muon表现不稳定：在CDP上有部分改进，但在water上始终逊于AdamW。

Conclusion: 矩阵结构化优化器在MLIP训练中一致优于AdamW，SOAP是最稳健的默认选择。准确率提升转化为显著的墙钟时间加速，且生成的MLIP在分子动力学模拟中保持物理保真度。优化器选择应被视为MLIP训练中与架构和数据集同等重要的设计维度，对于推动标签高效的基础势模型发展具有重要意义。

Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become a hallmark of AI for scientific simulation. While efforts on new architectures and datasets have led to increasingly accurate and general models, the choice of optimizer for training has largely remained unexplored, defaulting to Adam and its variants in the community. Here, we implement and systematically compare a class of recently proposed matrix-structured optimizers, including Muon, SOAP, and the hybrid SOAP-Muon, for training NequIP and Allegro MLIP models. We find that these optimizers can substantially outperform Adam in both convergence speed and final accuracy. SOAP and SOAP-Muon emerge as robust and consistently strong methods, while Muon only provides partial gains relative to Adam. The improvements are particularly pronounced under partial force supervision. Our results indicate that optimizer choice is an overlooked yet impactful design axis for MLIPs.

</details>


### [95] [DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02502)
*Yunhe Li,Hao Shi,Wenhao Liu,Mengzhe Ruan,Hanxu Hou,Zhongxiang Dai,Shuang Qiu,Linqi Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DemoPSD是一种针对大语言模型(LLM)推理训练的在线自蒸馏框架，通过"教师-学生分歧调制"机制解决标准在线自蒸馏(OPSD)中存在的特权信息泄露问题。其核心思想是构造一个反向KL重心(reverse-KL barycenter)目标分布，根据教师（有特权信息）和学生（无特权信息）分布的Jensen-Shannon分歧度，动态调整两者在蒸馏目标中的混合权重，从而在保留密集token级监督的同时抑制特权信息泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏(OPSD)虽然能通过引入教师模型的密集token级监督解决RLVR的信用分配瓶颈，但存在根本性缺陷：教师依赖特权信息(如正确答案)生成的条件分布会产生不可约的互信息差距I(y_t; y*|x, y_{<t}) > 0，导致学生编码答案相关的捷径(特权信息泄露)，抑制探索能力，损害跨域泛化性。现有方法(RLSD、HDPO、EGRSD、SRPO、DASD等)仅使用间接代理信号(教师熵、样本正确性、多教师共识)而非直接测量特权信息的影响程度。

Method: 1) **分歧度量**：在每个token位置用Jensen-Shannon散度(JSD)度量教师(带特权信息)与学生(不带特权信息)分布的差异d_t；2) **泄露衰减系数**：通过重缩放sigmoid函数α_t = (σ(β·d_t) - 0.5)·2·α_max将JSD转换为泄漏衰减系数（单调递增、有限值）；3) **反向KL重心目标**：π_target ∝ (π_teacher)^{1-α_t} · (π_student)^{α_t}，即教师和学生分布在log概率空间的几何插值；4) **选择性采纳原则**：低分歧token保留教师信号，高分歧token倾向于学生自身推理；5) **算法实现**：使用EMA副本作为参考，采用top-k蒸馏(probability floor)，按reprompting机制构建特权上下文。

Result: 在SciKnowEval四个科学领域(生物、化学、材料、物理)上，DemoPSD在mean@16、maj@16、best@16三项指标上均优于GRPO和SDPO，平均mean@16提升1.68(对SDPO)和5.21(对GRPO)，best@16提升2.82。训练熵比SDPO高33-98%，有效避免熵坍塌。在OOD的GPQA Extended基准上，DemoPSD平均准确率54.38%，比SDPO的46.47%高7.91%，且SDPO随训练退化，DemoPSD保持稳定。理论上证明了：(1)泄漏衰减定理：有效泄漏率严格小于SDPO，且衰减在泄漏风险最大的位置最强；(2)探索保持定理：在协方差条件下，DemoPSD目标的熵严格高于完整教师目标的熵。

Conclusion: DemoPSD通过分歧调制的反向KL重心目标有效解决了OPSD中的特权信息泄露问题，无需依赖间接代理信号。其理论保证(泄漏衰减+探索保持)与实验结果(域内精度+域外泛化+熵保持)一致，证明了在推理任务上对LLM进行自蒸馏时，保留学生自身推理能力的重要性。该方法为平衡密集token级监督与学生自主探索提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a practical method for training large language models (LLMs) to reason, where a single model acts as both the teacher and the student with different levels of information access. However, recent studies have found that the teacher's dense token-level supervision, conditioned on privileged information, can lead to overfitting to in-domain patterns, suppress exploration, and hurt cross-domain generalization, while also introducing a more fundamental issue: *privileged information leakage*, where the student encodes answer-dependent shortcuts that are unavailable at test time. We introduce **DemoPSD**, a novel framework that resolves such problems through the idea of *selective adoption of teacher guidance*. Instead of fitting the full teacher distribution, DemoPSD steers the student toward a *reverse-KL barycenter target*, a weighted geometric combination of the teacher and student distributions, that naturally balances learning from the teacher with preserving the student's own reasoning capacity. We measure the difference between their distributions and use such a discrepancy to adaptively control the blending at each token position. We provably show that DemoPSD achieves **(1)** *leakage attenuation*, i.e., effective mitigation of privileged information leakage; and **(2)** *exploration preservation*, i.e., preservation of exploration capacity under dense token-level distillation. Extensive experiments on SciKnowEval across four scientific fields show that DemoPSD outperforms both GRPO and SDPO while maintaining higher training entropy and robustly generalizing to out-of-distribution GPQA benchmarks.

</details>


### [96] [Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02512)
*Wentao Zhang,Liliana Hotsko,Woojeong Kim,Pengyu Nie,Stuart Shieber,Yuntian Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Program-as-Weights"(PAW)编程范式,将难以用规则精确描述的"模糊函数"从自然语言规范编译为小型、可本地执行、可版本管理的神经程序;具体实现为4B编译器基于自建的10M数据集FuzzyBench训练,为冻结的0.6B Qwen3解释器生成混合程序(离散伪程序+连续LoRA适配器),实现以1/50推理内存匹配Qwen3-32B提示性能,并可在MacBook M3上以30 tokens/s本地运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际编程任务(如日志告警、JSON修复、意图搜索排序)难以用规则/正则表达式精确实现,开发者普遍诉诸LLM API,但代价是失去本地性、可复现性并产生持续成本与隐私风险。本文旨在将基础模型的角色从"逐输入求解器"转变为"工具构建器":对每个函数定义一次性编译,得到可复用、可离线调用的神经制品。

Method: PAW采用三步流程:用户以自然语言描述函数 → 神经编译器生成"神经程序" → 冻结轻量级解释器本地执行。程序采用混合形式:离散伪程序(任务改写+示例,屏蔽原始规范中的拼写/歧义)+ 连续PEFT模块(LoRA)。具体使用两阶段编译流水线:(1)伪编译器Cp(Qwen3-4B-Instruct,免训练)生成p_discrete;(2)LoRA编译器CL(可训练的Qwen3-4B)读取规范和伪程序,通过64个学习前缀token的前缀位置隐藏状态,经LoRA mapper(均值池化+浅MLP+共享基投影,秩r=64,N=64基)生成每示例LoRA(~38.5M参数),注入冻结的0.6B Qwen3解释器。训练目标为冻结解释器对目标输出的负对数似然,梯度反传至CL和mapper。配套发布FuzzyBench-10M数据集(gpt-5.2生成,29个主题版本,800+子类别,已通过gpt-5.2与gpt-5-mini一致的验证测试集)。

Result: 在FuzzyBench上,0.6B Qwen3解释器执行PAW程序达73.78% EM,优于直接提示Qwen3-32B(68.70%),推理内存约1/50(~1.2 GB vs ~60 GB bf16);量化后Q4_K_M基+ Q4_0适配器仅~507 MB,在MacBook M3上达31.6 tokens/s。同一抽象可迁移到多模态:仅将编译器替换为Qwen3-VL-4B、保持0.6B文本解释器不变,即在CoSyn图表任务(Circuit 0.274、Chemical 0.414、Music 0.552)上击败≤4B的VLM基线。在噪声规范下退化极小(全噪声重负载-3.7%),归因于伪程序的去噪作用。五个案例研究覆盖日志监控、站点导航、语义搜索重排、ToolCall-15(93%)、多语言猜词游戏。GPT-2 124M路径亦可在浏览器端通过WebAssembly运行。消融实验显示:编译器生成LoRA比同基全微调高15.4点、比最强固定LoRA高21.7点;较复杂的映射器架构反而不如简单的均值池化+共享基设计。

Conclusion: PAW将基础模型定位为按需调用的工具构建器,通过"编译一次、运行多次"的模式实现小模型本地化、可复现、低成本执行模糊任务,代表通向"小模型作为运行时"(small-model future)的具体步骤。其编译器–解释器抽象天然支持跨任务(一个训练对应对无限规范)和跨模态(仅替换编译器),但当前存在局限:编译–解释对耦合、连续组件不可解释、仅验证单步任务、合成数据需外部验证、PEFT选择需经验比较。

Abstract: Many everyday programming tasks resist clean rule-based implementation, such as alerting on important log lines, repairing malformed JSON, or ranking search results by intent, and are increasingly outsourced to large language model APIs at the cost of locality, reproducibility, and price. We propose fuzzy-function programming: compiling such a function from a natural-language specification into a compact, locally-executable neural artifact. We instantiate this paradigm with Program-as-Weights (PAW), in which a 4B compiler trained on FuzzyBench, a 10M-example dataset we release, emits parameter-efficient adapters for a frozen, lightweight interpreter. A 0.6B Qwen3 interpreter executing PAW programs matches the performance of direct prompting of Qwen3-32B, while using roughly one fiftieth of the inference memory and running at 30 tokens/s on a MacBook M3. PAW reframes the foundation model from a per-input problem solver into a tool builder: invoked once per function definition, it produces a small reusable artifact whose subsequent calls per function application are cheap and offline.

</details>


### [97] [The Rollout Infrastructure Tax in Coding-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01415)
*Daniel Thi Graviet,Lovre Pesut,Ivan Dagelic,Vedran Jukic,Ivan Burazin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Rollout Infrastructure Tax"(rollout 基础设施税)概念，系统量化了四种编码智能体执行底座(单容器、托管沙箱、Kubernetes 容器、云虚拟机)在 RL 后训练中的延迟与成本开销。研究发现冷启动延迟最高相差 110 倍，在百万级 150 步轨迹规模下不同底座可造成 5316 额外 worker-hours 的差距，呼吁将执行底座视为训练系统的核心组成部分而非部署附属物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体 RL 后训练需要大量交互式软件 rollout(每个 rollout 包含环境创建、命令执行、观测收集、状态重置等系统操作)。已有工作虽指出 rollout 生成可占训练总时长 90% 以上，但执行底座本身引入的延迟从未被直接度量。由于每次 rollout 的微小延迟会在大规模训练中复利放大，作者主张应当将底座选择视为可测量、可优化的训练系统问题，而非实现细节。

Method: 在固定编码智能体工作负载的前提下，对四种执行底座(单容器、托管沙箱、K8s 编排容器、云虚拟机)进行受控对比。设计三档负载:T0(最小命令)、T1(预加载 python/attrs 仓库的代码检查)、T2(buggy commit 上的克隆、检查、打补丁与测试)。每个配置进行 100 次重复实验，采集 p50/p95 延迟，按 T_create+T_ready+ΣT_action,i+T_orchestration 框架分解。提出 worker-hours 投影公式 H_s(N)=N·L_s/3600，将实测延迟外推到 10K–1M 轨迹的训练规模，并归纳 150 步轨迹的复合开销。

Result: 1) 冷启动延迟在不同底座间最高相差 110 倍，托管沙箱最快、云虚拟机最慢；轻负载 T0 上差距最显著(>100×)，随负载加重至 T2 收窄至约 1.9×。2) 延迟分解显示不同底座的瓶颈不同:轻量容器主要耗时在 action 与 setup，强隔离/重编排底座在 startup 与 readiness 上开销更大。3) 短轨迹(10 步)上固定成本主导，长轨迹(150 步)上固定成本被摊薄，但每动作成本仍持续累加。4) 在 1M 条 150 步轨迹上，最慢底座 11,811 worker-hours、最快 6,495 worker-hours，差值 5,316 worker-hours(约 1.8×)。5) 据此提出三大设计要求:本地性感知的暖池、低延迟 action API、按 rollout 规模匹配隔离与扩缩容机制。

Conclusion: 执行底座选择是编码智能体 RL 中可测量且影响重大的训练系统变量，不存在通用最优解。底座开销随 rollout 长度变化呈现不同主导项，并在训练规模下复利放大。未来编码智能体 RL 系统应将底座视为训练核心组件，构建 rollout-native 栈:暖重用 + 缓存局部性 + 低延迟交互 + 高效重置 + 可扩展编排 + 适度隔离，从而在不改变模型、奖励函数与优化算法的前提下降低训练成本。

Abstract: Coding-agent reinforcement learning treats execution infrastructure as a background implementation detail, despite relying on large numbers of interactive software rollouts. This is a missed opportunity: measuring infrastructure overhead can reveal practical efficiency gains for RL post-training, where small per-rollout savings compound at scale. We present a comparative study of four execution substrates: single containers, hosted sandboxes, Kubernetes-orchestrated containers, and cloud virtual machines. We find up to $110\times$ variation in cold-start latency and a $1.8\times$ spread in projected worker-hours for one million 150-step trajectories. Our results suggest that future coding-agent RL systems should optimize execution substrates as part of the training system itself, not merely as deployment plumbing.

</details>


### [98] [DeadPool: Resilient LLM Training with Hot-Swapping via Zero-Overhead Checkpoint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01646)
*Haotian Xie,Junlin Chen,Mingkai Zheng,Lishan Yang,Zhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeadPool是一种面向大规模LLM训练的容错系统，通过零开销内存检查点与通信器在线重构协议实现节点热替换（hot-swapping），无需终止整个训练任务。系统在无故障运行时检查点开销为零，节点永久故障后恢复时间低于40秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大规模LLM训练使用上万块GPU持续训练数月，节点故障已成为常态。现有容错机制存在两难困境：检查点重启策略虽实现简单但产生非平凡的无故障运行开销与长恢复延迟；弹性容错策略（如Bamboo）虽避免重启但会降低训练吞吐量；现有内存检查点假设故障后内存可访问，不适用于永久性节点故障。在超算平台上，故障后需重新排队进一步加剧开销。作者旨在同时优化无故障开销与恢复成本两个目标。

Method: DeadPool基于PyTorch与Megatron-LM实现，包含三大组件：（1）异步卸载流水线——每训练迭代执行两阶段操作：D2H阶段将完整rank状态（含优化器状态分片、模型参数分片、元数据）通过专用CUDA流异步拷贝到主机固定内存；H2H阶段仅将优化器状态分片通过环形拓扑沿数据并行（DP）邻居节点复制，模型参数通过TP/PP同坐标健康rank在线重构。（2）错误检测与隔离——基于心跳和NCCL超时监控节点健康，分类瞬态/永久故障，将永久故障的节点替换为备用节点。（3）恢复策略——采用乒乓双缓冲保证任一时刻内存中存在有效恢复点；通过基于TCPStore的控制平面维护全局一致的恢复元数据；执行三阶段恢复：选择备用节点、重建通信拓扑与分片放置、从内存副本重构缺失状态。系统维持四项不变量：拓扑一致性、分片完整性、优化器可用性、步骤原子性。通过将副本放置在不同故障域（交换机/机架）支持k副本配置以容忍多节点故障。

Result: 在NERSC Perlmutter（HPE Cray EX，A100 GPU）和TACC Vista（Grace-Hopper，H200 GPU）两大生产超算系统上的实验表明：（1）弱扩展测试中2.3B模型在8至64节点范围内DeadPool与基线训练时间几乎一致，差异为系统噪声而非系统开销；Vista上7B/21B/65B模型同样验证零开销特性；（2）通信分解显示D2H与H2H开销远低于前向/反向计算窗口，能有效与计算重叠；（3）恢复延迟在模型规模（0.6B至50B）上保持稳定（128 GPU上），随集群规模从32扩展到512 GPU时仅从17.1秒增至29.8秒，主要由NCCL通信器重建主导；（4）相比检查点重启平均150秒的恢复时间，DeadPool热替换恢复快3.7倍以上；（5）真实故障模拟（2.3B模型、64节点、100K步、Meta故障率）显示DeadPool将故障恢复时间降至检查点重启的5.3%（18.8倍加速）。

Conclusion: DeadPool通过将节点故障恢复转化为在线拓扑修复问题，成功解耦了恢复性能与模型规模的耦合关系。该系统证明了在大规模LLM训练中实现无开销检查点与快速恢复的可行性，避免了基于检查点方法固有的重放和重启成本，是大规模系统上LLM容错训练的实用且可扩展的解决方案。未来工作包括改进控制平面容错性、扩展至更多训练框架、在更大规模上验证性能。

Abstract: State-of-the-art large language model (LLM) training takes tens of thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs) for months and encounters failures across the software and hardware stack. Existing fault-tolerance mechanisms either impose non-trivial overhead during failure-free execution or suffer from prolonged recovery latency, particularly under scenarios where a small subset of compute nodes experience permanent failures. %The tradeoff between failure-free overhead and recovery latency forms a space forms a Pareto frontier We present DeadPool to simultaneously address both optimization objectives. DeadPool incorporates a fault-tolerance mechanism that restores LLM training via hot-swapping, namely by replacing failed nodes with spare nodes without terminating the complete job. The hot-swapping of DeadPool is enabled by two ideas: First, it exploits an off-critical-path in-memory checkpointing mechanism for spatial redundancy. Second, it introduces a communicator reconstruction protocol that replaces failed nodes with spare nodes at runtime. DeadPool efficiently overlaps the in-memory checkpointing with computation, thus introducing zero overhead during error-free execution. Upon permanent node failures, DeadPool can rebuild memory states with minimal recomputation by leveraging in-memory checkpoints.
