We introduce Proximal Wavefunction Optimization (PWO), a principled trust-region algorithm that clips probability-ratio changes in the amplitude channel and phase increments in the phase channel. PWO avoids explicit matrix inversion, reuses samples across multiple updates, and combines the scalability of first-order optimization with theoretical guarantees. Across Ising and frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ one- and two-dimensional spin systems, PWO improves stability and wall-clock convergence over Adam, minSR, and SPRING. Finally, we fine-tune a $1.5$B-parameter RWKV-7 model, demonstrating NQS optimization at a scale over three orders of magnitude beyond prior work.

</details>


### [154] [DecompRL: Solving Harder Problems by Learning Modular Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02390)
*Juliette Decugis,Fabian Gloeckle,Francis Bach,Taco Cohen,Gabriel Synnaeve*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DecompRL是一种强化学习算法，训练大语言模型将编程问题分解为可独立实现的子函数，并将其实现进行组合，从而在固定的GPU推理预算下产生k^n个候选解，将计算瓶颈从昂贵的GPU推理转移到廉价的CPU评估，GPU token成本降低约50倍，在LiveCodeBench和CodeContests上解决了标准生成无法触及的难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法存在两大局限：(1)重复采样随尝试次数线性增加GPU成本；(2)带可验证奖励的RL提升单次准确率但牺牲了多样性(pass@k在k>100时下降)。当基础策略产生正确答案的概率接近零时，无论采样或梯度信号都无法克服过大的搜索空间。因此需要一种方法在不按比例增加GPU算力的情况下解决更难的问题，将瓶颈从昂贵的GPU推理转移到廉价的CPU验证。

Method: DecompRL训练两个协作策略：分解策略π(D)将问题分解为n个子函数(以docstring和签名表示)，实现策略π(I|D)为每个子函数生成k个实现。组合n个函数的k个实现可产生多达k^n个完整解。关键技术包括：(1)层次化策略梯度估计器，利用重组降低梯度方差(由Hoeffding分解证明Var(ĝ_hierarchical)≤Var(ĝ_standard))；(2)logmeanexp_β多样本目标函数，平滑插值于均值和最大值之间(β→∞为均值，β→0为最大值)；(3)留一法(leave-one-out)基线进行方差缩减；(4)分解策略和实现策略的序贯交替训练以处理多智能体信用分配问题；(5)使用PPO无critic优化。

Result: 在LiveCodeBench(2024/08-2025/02)和CodeContests数据集上，使用Qwen 2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B Instruct和Code World Model 32B三个模型进行实验。DecompRL在每问题token预算超过10^5时优于GRPO、pass@8训练、SPO和logmeanexp基线，在LiveCodeBench困难子集上解决了35%的问题(2024/08-2025/02)。在512次评估时，GPU token成本降低约50倍(4k vs 198k)，时钟时间提速最高3.6倍。但存在"格式税"：无RL训练的层次推理在pass@1上比标准推理低3个百分点，RL训练可弥补此差距。消融实验表明logmeanexp目标、序贯训练和留一法基线均为关键组件。

Conclusion: DecompRL通过模块化分解和组合将推理扩展的计算瓶颈从GPU转移到廉价的CPU评估，是一种强大的探索工具而非标准RL后训练的替代品。它可作为专家收集标准RL无法获得的新解，再通过监督微调蒸馏到pass@1策略中，构成explorer/distiller管线。该方法不仅适用于代码生成，还可推广到任何层次可分解且验证廉价而生成昂贵的领域(形式证明分解为引理、芯片设计模块化、科学代码库等)。核心启示在于：硬探索问题可通过训练专门的探索策略来生成高质量数据，这些行为是标准pass@1目标训练的最终策略无法自行发现的。

Abstract: How can Large Language Models (LLMs) solve problems they currently cannot? Repeated sampling scales test-time compute but GPU cost grows linearly with attempts, while reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards improves single-attempt accuracy at the expense of sample diversity. Both strategies ultimately fail when the base policy has near-zero probability of producing a correct solution: no amount of sampling or gradient signal can overcome a search space that is simply too large. We take a different approach: rather than sampling harder, we make the task easier by decomposing problems into smaller, independently solvable sub-functions whose implementations can be recombined. Since off-the-shelf models are not trained for this modular generation, we introduce DecompRL, an RL algorithm that explicitly learns to decompose and implement hierarchical code structures. Recombining $k$ implementations of $n$ modules yields up to $k^{n}$ candidate solutions, shifting the bottleneck from GPU inference to cheap CPU evaluation and cutting GPU token cost by $\sim$50$\times$. On LiveCodeBench and CodeContests (Qwen~2.5~7B, Code World Model~32B), DecompRL outperforms standard and diversity-optimized RL baselines beyond $10^5$ tokens per problem, solving problems that standard generation cannot reach.

</details>


### [155] [Extreme Adaptive Transformer for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02437)
*Sanjeev Shrestha,Hui Liu,Yifan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Exformer，一种面向水文径流时间序列预测的极值自适应Transformer模型。其核心是引入由Local、Stride和Extreme三种稀疏注意力组成的事件感知注意力机制，根据查询令牌是否对应极值事件自适应地选择键集合，从而在建模常规时序依赖的同时显式保留稀有极值事件间的依赖关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在时间序列预测中虽能捕获长程依赖，但对所有时间步一视同仁，难以充分表征高度偏斜且稀有但关键的极值事件（如洪水径流峰值）。现有极值感知方法（如DAN、PFformer）侧重表示学习或嵌入策略，未在注意力机制层面区分正常/极值令牌，导致标准全注意力计算冗余且稀释对稀有极值模式的关注。

Method: Exformer采用编码器-线性分解架构：先对输入序列进行季节-趋势分解，季节分量通过Exformer编码器建模，趋势分量由线性层预测。编码器采用维度不变嵌入并按时序分块，每个块根据高斯混合模型（GMM）异常得分与阈值被赋予正常/极值标签。提出的极值自适应注意力机制包含三个组件：Local组件允许正常查询仅关注窗口内的正常键以捕获短程依赖；Stride组件允许正常查询以固定步长关注正常键以捕获周期依赖；Extreme组件仅允许极值查询关注其他极值键。最终注意力掩码通过Dozer掩码（Local+Stride）与极值感知掩码的逐元素与运算合成，实现线性计算复杂度O((w+s)I/p + n_e²)，其中n_e≪I/p为极值块令牌数。

Result: 在Santa Clara县四个水文数据集（Ross、Saratoga、UpperPen、SFC）的3天预测（h=288）实验中，Exformer在8项RMSE/MAPE对比中取得7项最优：MAPE在四个数据集均最低，RMSE在Ross、Saratoga、UpperPen三个数据集最低。相比PFformer，RMSE提升0.2%-5.0%，MAPE降低20.0%-50.0%；相比DAN，MAPE降低28.6%-73.3%。消融实验验证三个组件均有效，Extreme组件单独使用即接近完整模型性能。在计算效率方面，Exformer仅需31.60 GFLOPs和240.85 MB显存，较PFformer（5.9倍FLOPs节省）、DAN（8.3倍）和NEC+（18.4倍）显著降低，同时维持准确率优势。参数敏感性分析表明较高的极值阈值百分位（选择性更强）通常带来更优预测性能。

Conclusion: Exformer通过在注意力机制层面引入查询自适应的极值感知组件，在不显著增加计算成本的前提下显著提升了Transformer对高度偏斜且含稀有极值事件的时间序列预测能力。实验证明，极值感知稀疏注意力是处理不平衡、高偏度时间序列预测的有效方向，未来可推广至其他含稀有关键事件的时序领域。

Abstract: Time series forecasting remains challenging when the underlying data contain rare but critical extreme events. This issue is particularly important in hydrologic forecasting, where streamflow distributions are often highly skewed and extreme peaks can have substantial impacts on flood monitoring, water resource management, and early warning systems. Although Transformer-based forecasting models have achieved strong performance by modeling long-range temporal dependencies, they typically treat all time points uniformly and may therefore underrepresent rare extreme patterns. In this paper, we propose the Extreme-Adaptive Transformer (Exformer), a forecasting framework designed to explicitly model temporal dependencies involving both normal and extreme events. Exformer introduces an extreme-adaptive attention mechanism composed of three sparse components: Local, Stride, and Extreme. The Local and Stride components capture short-term and periodic temporal dependencies, respectively, while the Extreme component selectively models event-aware dependencies between normal and extreme streamflow patterns. Experiments on four real-world hydrologic streamflow datasets show that Exformer achieves superior 3-day forecasting performance compared with state-of-the-art baselines. Our findings demonstrate that explicitly incorporating extreme-aware attention improves the forecasting capacity of Transformer models on imbalanced time series with rare but consequential events.

</details>


### [156] [Understanding the Robustness of Distributed Self-Supervised Learning Frameworks Against Non-IID Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02447)
*Xuanyu Chen,Nan Yang,Shuai Wang,Dong Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对分布式自监督学习（D-SSL）框架在非IID数据下的鲁棒性进行了严格的理论分析，证明了基于掩码图像建模（MIM）的D-SSL本质上比基于对比学习（CL）的D-SSL对数据异构性更具鲁棒性，且去中心化SSL的鲁棒性随平均网络连接度提升而增强（联邦学习不弱于去中心化学习）。基于理论洞察，作者提出了MAR损失函数（MIM目标与局部-全局对齐正则化的结合），并在多种模型架构和分布式设置下进行了大量实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式自监督学习（D-SSL）旨在利用分散的无标签数据进行训练，但面临数据异构性（非IID）的关键挑战。现有方法（如FedU、Orchestra、L-DAWA）多基于对比学习（CL），且MIM在分布式场景下的应用尚未充分探索。更根本的问题是：不同D-SSL框架对非IID数据的鲁棒性差异缺乏理论理解——例如FedU在去中心化设置下是否仍保持鲁棒？基于MIM的D-SSL是否比CL更具鲁棒性？网络连接架构如何影响鲁棒性？这些问题构成了论文的核心研究动机。

Method: 1. **问题形式化**：建立简化的非IID数据生成模型（每个客户端拥有2个高频类和1个低频类，全局共2N类），并在有向图𝒢=(𝒱,ℰ)上形式化分布式训练目标，分别针对去中心化学习（DecL）和联邦学习（FL）。
2. **SSL目标建模**：将CL（SimSiam形式）和MIM（对齐形式）转化为可分析的数学目标（含正则化项的二次型形式）。
3. **表示能力向量（RV）定义**：通过学习矩阵W的行空间对标准基向量的投影范数来量化特征空间的表示能力。
4. **核心定理**：推导MIM和CL在DecL和FL下的局部及全局RV的上下界（定理4.2和4.3），证明MIM的灵敏度严格小于CL（定理4.4），并证明灵敏度随平均连接度|Ā|增大而减小（推论4.5），即FL不弱于DecL（定理4.6）。
5. **MAR损失**：基于理论洞察，将MIM目标与自适应最大均值差异（A-MMD）对齐正则化项结合，并采用基于客户端参与次数的余弦衰减权重调度。

Result: 1. **理论结果**：在高维极限下，证明MIM-based D-SSL的灵敏度严格小于CL-based D-SSL；DecL的鲁棒性随平均连接度单调提升；FL的鲁棒性不弱于DecL。
2. **实验验证**（表1）：在ResNet和ViT上，MAE（MIM）的IID与非IID性能差距始终小于SimSiam（CL），如CIFAR-10上MAE+ViT的标签非IID下降仅1.70%，而SimSiam+ViT下降2.82%。
3. **连接度影响**（图2a）：DecL的微调精度随平均连接度|Ā|从3增至20而提升，且不超过FL的精度。
4. **MAR损失效果**（图2b、表2）：在不同Dirichlet参数（α=0.001~1）下，MAR一致优于vanilla MIM；与SOTA联邦SSL方法对比，FedMAR（ResNet-18）在CIFAR-10/100上达到92.70%/70.82%，FedMAR（Tiny-ViT）在ImageNet上达到75.99%，均优于FedU、FedEMA、Orchestra、LDAWA等基线。
5. **消融研究**：A-MMD（均值带宽）优于余弦相似度和vanilla MMD；动态余弦衰减权重（1e-1→1e-3）取得最佳性能（54.91%）。
6. **隐私与通信开销**：MAR额外通信开销约为模型大小的1%~11%，可通过差分隐私进一步增强保护。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上系统分析了分布式自监督学习在不同SSL范式（MIM vs CL）和网络架构（FL vs DecL）下对非IID数据的鲁棒性，得出两个核心洞察：（i）MIM本质上比CL更具鲁棒性；（ii）连接度越高、去中心化程度越低（如FL），鲁棒性越强。基于此提出的MAR损失作为理论指导算法设计的实例，实验充分验证了理论预测和MAR的实际有效性。这项工作为未来D-SSL算法的设计提供了原则性的理论基础和指导框架。

Abstract: Recent research has introduced distributed self-supervised learning (D-SSL) approaches to leverage vast amounts of unlabeled decentralized data. However, D-SSL faces the critical challenge of data heterogeneity, and there is limited theoretical understanding of how different D-SSL frameworks respond to this challenge. To fill this gap, we present a rigorous theoretical analysis of the robustness of D-SSL frameworks under non-IID (non-independent and identically distributed) settings. Our results show that pre-training with Masked Image Modeling (MIM) is inherently more robust to heterogeneous data than Contrastive Learning (CL), and that the robustness of decentralized SSL increases with average network connectivity, implying that federated learning (FL) is no less robust than decentralized learning (DecL). These findings provide a solid theoretical foundation for guiding the design of future D-SSL algorithms. To further illustrate the practical implications of our theory, we introduce MAR loss, a refinement of the MIM objective with local-to-global alignment regularization. Extensive experiments across model architectures and distributed settings validate our theoretical insights, and additionally confirm the effectiveness of MAR loss as an application of our analysis.

</details>

### [157] [CADENZA in Action: Breaking the Monolith with Intent-Dependent Plan Spaces for Semantic Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01468)
*Jaehyun Ha,Yongjoo Park,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: CADENZA是一个语义算子优化器，将自然语言意图(intent)分解为多个逻辑计划，为每个计划绑定具体物理实现，并通过贝叶斯优化在用户指定的质量-延迟-成本偏好下选出最优计划。其核心创新在于打破现有优化器对LLM/嵌入模型等单一整体实现的依赖，转而将意图编译为逻辑DAG并支持多目标权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义查询处理引擎的优化器将整个语义算子视为单一整体实现(如LLM、嵌入模型或级联),强制用户在昂贵的模型调用与廉价但无法捕捉意图细粒度语义的替代方案之间做权衡。例如,将整个产品描述嵌入单个向量会稀释品牌等细粒度信号。根因在于这些系统从未深入审视意图本身,无法将意图分解为更细粒度的专业化步骤,从而也无法同时实现更便宜和更准确的执行。

Method: CADENZA采用四级架构:(1)目录管理器维护任务特定算子(结构化/属性/关联/生成/潜在五大类)及任务无关算子,按symbolic/specialized/general-purpose/composite四个后端家族组织物理实现;(2)逻辑规划器通过LLM合成多个种子计划并经规则变换扩展为结构多样化的候选逻辑DAG;(3)物理规划器为每个任务特定算子编译"路由集成"(routed ensemble),通过LLM合成数据感知路由器将元组分桶派发到N个后端;(4)在验证集上通过贝叶斯优化调优路由阈值和后端参数Θ,使用Q-L-C效用函数U = w_q·Q - w_l·L̂ - w_c·Ĉ选择最优计划。

Result: 在SemBench E-Commerce场景(SF=100)中,CADENZA的最优计划(Plan C: NER+ImgObj+TxtImgSim)取得Q=0.82、L=566s、C=$0.80,显著优于单一LLM基线(Q=0.76, L=25323s, C=$2.59)和嵌入级联基线(Q=0.63, L=4208s, C=$1.20)。偏好切换实验表明:Balanced偏好下Plan C胜出,而Budget偏好下更轻量的Plan A(NER+Caption+NLI)获胜,证明偏好不仅调节路由参数,还能改变最优逻辑计划本身的选择。

Conclusion: CADENZA通过将意图分解为替代逻辑计划、为每个计划编译异构后端的路由集成,并在多目标优化下调优,使意图相关的语义查询优化变得透明且实用。其交互式Web演示支持用户探索意图分解、计划优化过程以及偏好变化如何导致不同的优胜计划,系统可通过轻量级调度钩子和适配器模式集成到现有语义查询处理引擎中。

Abstract: Semantic query processing engines execute semantic operators, whose behavior is specified by natural-language intents, via model inference over multimodal data. Most existing optimizers optimize the operators at the granularity of monolithic implementations -- such as LLMs and embedding models -- forcing a trade-off between expensive model calls and cheaper alternatives that fail to capture intent-dependent semantics. We present CADENZA, a semantic operator optimizer that compiles an intent into decomposed steps, selects concrete physical implementations for each step, and tunes their parameters under user-specified quality-latency-cost preferences. In this demonstration, users interact with CADENZA through a web interface over multimodal databases, exploring how an intent is decomposed into alternative plans, how each plan is optimized, and how different preferences yield different winning plans.

</details>


### [158] [The General Stability of Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01546)
*Houming Chen,H. V. Jagadish*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出"一般稳定性"(General Stability)概念，作为基于加权评分函数排名的稳健性度量，将传统的精确稳定性(Exact Stability)从"非匹配即零分"推广为基于距离的连续评分机制，并设计了在二维精确算法、多维采样算法和针对拟凸距离函数的Conv-SC多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确稳定性要求扰动权重后的排名与目标排名完全一致才给予信用，这过于粗糙：例如，仅在排名底部交换两个接近的候选者与替换第一名候选者都被视为完全失败。论文通过具体例子(CWUR前30名大学案例：精确稳定性极低(~6.15×10⁻⁶)但前5名稳定)说明精确稳定性无法区分"根本性不稳定"与"微小局部扰动"，因此需要距离敏感的稳定性度量。

Method: (1) 一般稳定性定义：Stab(r₀) = (1/Vol(W*)) Σ Vol(R(r)) exp(-dist(r₀, r))，使用exp(-dist)作为相似性核；(2) 实用距离函数：首次差异位置距离、指数位置加权的Kendall's Tau和Spearman's Footrule距离；(3) 2D扫描算法GSC_2d：时间复杂度O(n²(D+logn))；(4) 多维无偏采样器GSC_md：最坏情形样本复杂度N=Θ((1-s)/s)，在s指数级小时呈非多项式；(5) Conv-SC算法：识别拟凸距离函数(如0/∞距离和首次差异位置距离)的特性，使距离为r内的所有排名区域的并集构成凸集，从而将稳定性计算归约为凸体体积近似问题，借助hit-and-run方法可在多项式时间(O*(d⁵))内求解。

Result: 在8个真实数据集(QS、THE、CWUR、CSMetrics、MPI、CSRankings、NBA、EPI)上的实验表明：(1) 距离敏感稳定性分数彼此高度相关(0.968-0.998)但与精确稳定性相关性低(0.275-0.391)；(2) 精确稳定性对下半部相邻交换反应剧烈(平均归一化变化0.766)，而距离敏感分数变化接近零(8.36×10⁻³至5.30×10⁻⁴)；(3) GSC_md和Conv-SC的实测误差远小于请求的30%容差(平均6.6%和7.5%)；(4) 2D情形下GSC_2d在毫秒级完成；(5) 生成数据和MPI数据上的维度扩展实验显示Conv-SC随维度增长平稳，而GSC_md在精确稳定性值小时迅速进入高运行时区间，验证了Conv-SC的多项式时间优势。

Conclusion: 一般稳定性提供了一个灵活的距离敏感框架，恢复了精确稳定性作为特例，使用户能根据应用需求指定哪些排名变化是重要的。理论上证明了GSC_md在固定相对误差保证下不具有多项式时间最坏情形，但通过识别拟凸距离函数这一结构化子类，Conv-SC算法能够将稳定性计算归约为凸体体积近似，从而获得多项式时间保证。实验证实了该方法在真实数据上既能避免对微小变化的过度反应，又能在高维情形下保持可行性。

Abstract: Rankings derived from weighted scoring functions are widely used in settings such as university rankings and employment candidate evaluations. Since ranking weights are often chosen by organizations or analysts, ranking stability asks whether a reported ranking persists under reasonable weight changes. Prior work on stable rankings formalizes this idea through volume-based stability, which measures the fraction of the weight space that induces the target ranking exactly. This exact-match requirement can be too blunt: once a perturbed weight vector produces a different ranking, exact stability gives it no credit, whether the change replaces the top-ranked item or only swaps two nearly tied lower-ranked items. We propose general stability, a distance-based generalization that aggregates ranking regions according to a user-defined distance from the target ranking. This lets users specify which ranking changes matter in the application, while recovering exact stability as a special case. Our algorithmic focus is stability computation: given a reported or user-specified ranking and a distance function, estimate its general-stability score. We give a two-dimensional sweep algorithm and an unbiased multidimensional sampler that extend exact-stability methods, and analyze why sampling can scale poorly as the dimension grows. Motivated by this scaling challenge, we identify quasiconvex distance functions as a tractable subclass and introduce Conv-SC, which reduces stability computation for this subclass to convex-volume approximation, where randomized polynomial-time methods are available. Experiments on eight real datasets and generated instances show that distance-sensitive stability gives informative real-data results, that our estimators are accurate and practical, and that Conv-SC improves scaling with dimension for quasiconvex distance functions.

</details>


### [159] [pykci: A Compact Urban Knowledge Graph for Semantic and Spatial Queries using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01605)
*Huynh Duc An Son Nguyen,Lukas Arzoumanidis,Youness Dehbi*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: pykci是一个开源的端到端Python系统，将CityGML 2.0语义3D城市模型转换为基于Neo4j的紧凑型城市知识图谱（支持R-tree空间索引），并通过模型无关的text-to-Cypher机制使大语言模型能够以自然语言对图谱进行复杂语义与空间查询，同时支持到CityGML的无损往返导出和OGC 3D Tiles可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CityGML虽是语义3D城市模型的事实标准，但其XML编码面向交换而非分析；现有关系型后端（如3DCityDB）需要复杂多表连接查询，且掩盖了城市数据本质上的图结构。通用大语言模型缺乏领域知识（如区分GroundSurface与RoofSurface），而将整座城市嵌入模型（如CityGPT）则无法跨城市泛化或随数据更新。城市数字孪生（UDT）亟需一个紧凑、可查询、且支持自然语言交互的城市知识库。

Method: 1) 设计五条图模式原则：有向无环结构、紧凑性（折叠GML包装元素为边属性）、无损性（保留标识符、属性、排序、XLink等用于CityGML重建）、数据集幂等性（用MERGE语句避免重复）、空间索引（Neo4j Spatial的R-tree）。2) 五类节点（特征、内部特征、几何、主题、上下文）与三类关系（分解、分类、上下文）。3) 端到端Python流水线：CityGML→Neo4j入库、OGC 3D Tiles可视化导出、Cypher驱动的CityGML无损回导。4) 文本到Cypher机制：将紧凑的图模式作为上下文输入LLM，模型生成Cypher直接在图上执行，支持本地开源权重模型与商业模型。

Result: 1) 损失评估：FZK-Haus LoD0-4（27万实例）和Railway Scene LoD3（10个CityGML模块、118万实例）均实现100%元素、属性、文本和坐标覆盖的无损往返。2) 性能基准（汉堡LoD2数据集，38.8万建筑）：入库耗时873s（与3DCityKG的872s相当，3DCityDB为626s）；存储11.4GB（比3DCityKG小约40%）；节点和边数比3DCityKG少6倍和4倍以上。3) 查询性能（20条预定义查询）：生成查询最短（~290字符），净数据库查询时间最快（0.37s，3DCityKG为2.10s，3DCityDB为2.62s），且所有问题均正确求解。4) 应用展示：屋顶材料丰富、立面开洞检测、城市热岛代理指标、光伏适用性评分等下游任务均可通过单跳图遍历完成。

Conclusion: pykci将语义3D城市模型以紧凑、可自然语言访问的知识图谱形式集成进城市数字孪生，在保持数据私密性（本地推理）、降低LLM上下文成本、支持精确可审计回答方面具有明显优势。其局限在于依赖在线数据库作为外部记忆，且抽象了CityGML结构，不利于子图匹配等细粒度结构比较。面向CityGML 3.0、多源异构数据融合、更高级空间/语义查询是未来方向。

Abstract: CityGML, the OGC standard for modeling, storage, and exchange of semantic 3D city models, describes urban objects with detailed semantics, geometry, and topology. Yet this richness is difficult to query directly: CityGML's XML encoding is designed for exchange rather than analysis, and relational mappings expose it through schemas requiring expert knowledge. We present pykci (Python Knowledge Graph for Cities), an open-source system that transforms CityGML 2.0 datasets into a compact urban knowledge graph in Neo4j and makes it queryable in natural language. The graph schema covers all thematic feature modules of CityGML 2.0 across all levels of detail and is spatially indexed with an R-tree for efficient geometric retrieval. A complete end-to-end Python pipeline ingests CityGML datasets into the knowledge graph, exports them to OGC 3D Tiles for interactive visualization, and supports lossless round-trip export of all content back to CityGML. For querying, the graph is paired with a large language model through a model-agnostic text-to-Cypher mechanism: the graph schema is supplied as context, and the model translates natural-language questions into Cypher queries executed against the graph. We evaluate both a locally running open-weight model, which keeps sensitive city data on-premise, and a state-of-the-art commercial model for the most demanding spatial and semantic queries. Answers are grounded in exact city data rather than the model's parametric memory, reducing hallucination and providing auditable provenance for every response. We demonstrate the system on open-government CityGML LoD2 datasets from Hamburg, Germany, including complex semantic and spatial queries such as identifying roof surfaces suitable for greening. pykci enables urban planners, GIS practitioners, and citizens to interact with semantic 3D city models without expertise in query languages and database schemas.

</details>


### [160] [AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01647)
*Zhaoyan Sun,Shan Zhong,Daizhou Wen,Jiaxing Han,Guoliang Li,Ying Yan,Peng Zhang,Yu Su,Xiang Qi,Baolin Sun,Chengyuan Yang,Tao Fang,Huaiyu Ruan*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticDataBench，一个面向基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据科学智能体（data agents）的综合性评测基准。该基准覆盖 15 个垂直领域（包括 5 个来自金融科技公司的真实 B2B 业务场景），通过引入"数据科学技能"概念来量化任务覆盖度，结合层次聚类与 LLM 任务生成方法，构建细粒度、高质量的评测集，用于系统评估数据智能体在多样化数据科学工作流中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据科学旨在从异构原始数据中提取可执行洞见，但传统流程高度依赖数据科学家的人工投入。虽然基于 LLM 的数据智能体（data agents）已展现出自动化数据科学工作流的潜力，但该领域缺乏能够在大规模、多样化场景下进行细粒度评估的综合性基准，制约了对智能体能力的严谨衡量。

Method: 1. **数据收集**：汇集来自 15 个垂直领域的真实数据集与任务，其中包含 5 个来自头部金融科技公司的真实 B2B 业务用例。2. **技能建模**：提出"数据科学技能（data science skills）"概念，刻画数据处理中反复出现的操作模式；利用 Stack Overflow 上大规模任务解答，通过技能对齐的层次聚类方法提取代表性技能。3. **真实任务筛选**：针对真实业务任务，按技能组合的多样性最大化原则筛选任务–解答对，确保覆盖广泛的实践场景。4. **合成任务生成**：针对缺乏真实数据的领域，提出基于 LLM 的系统性任务生成方法，依据已抽取的技能自动构造工作流与任务。5. **评测实施**：使用标注完备的基准与开源测试平台对当前最先进的（state-of-the-art）数据智能体进行评估，并提供技能维度的细粒度洞见。

Result: 基于所构建的评测基准，对主流数据智能体进行了实证评估，并从技能粒度提供了详细的性能分析与洞察，有助于揭示不同智能体在各项数据科学能力上的强弱表现（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。

Conclusion: AgenticDataBench 通过融合真实业务场景与系统性合成任务，以技能为度量单位，实现了对 LLM 数据智能体的全面、细粒度评测。该基准及其开源测试平台有望推动数据智能体领域的可复现研究与能力对比，加速自动化数据科学的落地。

Abstract: Data science aims to derive actionable insights from heterogeneous raw data, unlocking the value of the massive amounts of data generated in modern society. Automating this process is essential to reducing labor-intensive efforts for data scientists and enabling scalable data-driven applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based data agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate data science workflows. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks to rigorously evaluate these agents across diverse scenarios with fine-grained granularity. To address this gap, we propose AgenticDataBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring realistic tasks spanning diverse domains with fine-grained ground-truth labels. This enables evaluations to capture the diversity and complexity of data science workflows and the detailed performance of agents. First, to cover diverse domains, we collect real datasets and tasks from 15 vertical domains, including 5 real-world B2B use cases from a leading fintech company. Second, to remove redundancy in real-world tasks and generate high-quality tasks for domains lacking real data, we introduce data science skills, recurring data-centric operational patterns, and quantify benchmark coverage by the number of skills included. Representative skills are extracted from large-scale task solutions on Stack Overflow using skill-aligned hierarchical clustering. Third, for real-world business tasks, we select task-solution pairs that maximize diversity in skill composition, ensuring broad coverage of practical scenarios. Fourth, to generate realistic tasks for devise domains without real tasks, we propose a systematic LLM-based task generation approach to create workflows and tasks based on these skills. Finally, we evaluate state-of-the-art data agents using our annotated benchmark and open-sourced testbed, providing detailed skill-level insights.

</details>


### [161] [HNSW with Accuracy Guarantees Using Graph Spanners -- A Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02338)
*Minghao Li,Raghav Mittal,Sanjivni Rana,Suraj Shetiya,Gautam Das,Nick Koudas*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"Certify-then-Rectify"(CTR)的创新框架,通过结合HNSW的快速启发式搜索与基于图spanner理论的精确恢复算法,为近似最近邻搜索提供准确性保证。核心思想是:首先用无分布假设的统计证书(certifier)评估HNSW搜索结果的质量,仅在证书显示结果质量低下时才升级到精确恢复算法(MBV),从而实现平均情况下的HNSW速度与最坏情况下的精确性兼顾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HNSW虽然是对数复杂度且经验性能强大的行业标准近似最近邻搜索方法,但其贪心图遍历是启发式的,不提供正确性的理论保证。在高维空间中,贪心搜索常陷入局部极小值,无法检索到真正的最近邻。在自动驾驶安全模型训练中的"困难负样本"挖掘、神经检索与符号逻辑结合的系统(如法律先例检索、蛋白质结构识别)等高风险应用中,即使少量缺失也会导致训练数据噪声或LLM"幻觉"。现有通过调参提升召回率的方法收益递减,无法保证正确性。因此亟需一个既能保持HNSW速度又能提供严格准确性保证的框架。

Method: CTR框架包含两大组件:(1) **认证阶段(Certify)**:利用Conformal Risk Control(CRC)和Learn-then-Test(LTT)对HNSW内部搜索轨迹(包括距离几何、搜索范围、路径稳定性等特征)进行无分布假设的统计认证,判断是否满足目标召回率τ。(2) **纠正阶段(Rectify)**:使用Metric Bound Verification(MBV)进行精确恢复。具体技术包括:**Stochastic Stretch Estimation(SSE)**——将HNSW底层图视为几何spanner,通过极值理论(EVT)用GEV分布拟合块最大值采样来估计最大拉伸因子t;**Stretch-Bounded Expansion from Query(SBE-Q)**——将查询点q作为虚拟节点插入图,以t'×d̂_k为半径进行Dijkstra扩展,保证包含真实近邻;**Metric Bound Verification(MBV)**——通过递归下界剪枝(LBP)和椭圆剪枝(EP)利用三角不等式减少距离计算;**Incremental Reservoir Tail Patching**——高效更新查询插入后的拉伸因子估计。该方法还扩展到过滤搜索(F-SBE-Q)和基于磁盘的DiskANN。

Result: 在SIFT1M、GIST1M、DEEP1M以及T2I-10M/100M等基准数据集上的大量实验表明:(1)MBV将距离计算次数(NDC)大幅减少——SIFT1M上低至2.51%的基节点,即使在更难的高维GIST1M上也仅约5.6%;(2)CTR在所有三个数据集和不同τ值下始终优于ConANN,在SIFT1M的τ=0.85时以1.7k QPS达到91%合规率,显著优于ConANN的67%;(3)CRC/LTT在F1分数上优于DARTH召回率预测器,特别是在严格目标(τ=0.95)下差距更大(0.865-0.874 vs 0.709);(4)扩展到过滤搜索和DiskANN均有效;(5)从10M扩展到100M时,NDC比例从5.55%降至2.33%,证明在大规模数据集上CTR的效率优势更明显;(6)定理6.3的端到端保证得到经验验证,CRC/LTT的召回不足均低于理论界。

Conclusion: 本文成功弥合了启发式ANN搜索速度与精确检索严谨性之间的差距。CTR框架通过"先认证后纠正"的策略,在平均情况下提供HNSW级别的速度,同时在最坏情况下保证精确搜索的正确性。理论贡献包括:将HNSW重新解释为几何spanner、基于极值理论的拉伸因子估计(SSE)、保证精确恢复的SBE-Q扩展方法,以及使用Conformal Risk Control提供分布无关的端到端召回保证(定理6.3)。实验证明该框架在标准HNSW、过滤搜索(ACORN)和磁盘搜索(DiskANN)等多种场景下均优于现有方法,并可自然扩展到大规模数据集。代码已开源,为需要高可靠性最近邻检索的高风险AI应用提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs serve as the industry standard due to their logarithmic complexity and strong empirical performance. However, HNSW relies on greedy graph traversal, a heuristic that provides no theoretical guarantees of correctness. In this paper, we propose a novel "Certify-then-Rectify" framework that bridges the gap between the speed of heuristic search and the rigor of exact retrieval. Rather than discarding HNSW, our approach first employs a distribution-free statistical certifier to dynamically evaluate the quality of a standard HNSW search with minimal overhead. If certification indicates that the retrieved neighbors are of low quality, the framework safely escalates to a rigorous exact recovery algorithm. To make this exact recovery computationally feasible, we reinterpret the HNSW graph as a geometric spanner and utilize Extreme Value Theory to stochastically estimate its maximum empirical stretch factor. This allows us to mathematically bound the maximum distance of true nearest neighbors. Extensive evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our tiered framework delivers the average-case speed of HNSW while ensuring the worst-case correctness of exact search and outperforming other applicable approaches.

</details>

### [162] [Mixture-of-Parallelisms: Towards Memory-Efficient Training Stack for Mixture-of-Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01844)
*Xuan-Phi Nguyen,Shrey Pandit,Yiran Zhao,Semih Yavuz,Silvio Savarese,Shafiq Joty*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP),一种面向万亿参数稀疏 MoE 模型在百万 token 上下文下的内存高效训练栈。其核心思想是放弃"一刀切"的单一全局并行方案,转而对模型的不同组件(稠密路径、注意力、专家 FFN、词表投影、优化器状态)分别采用最适合其瓶颈的并行策略,并在同一组 W 个 rank 上使用重叠子组而非笛卡尔积,从而实现 4.7–8.2× 相对于精心调优的 FSDP2 基线的单 GPU 吞吐提升,并支持在不到 12 个 8×H200 节点上以百万上下文进行无损的万亿参数训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 万亿参数稀疏 MoE 模型在近百万 token 上下文下的训练瓶颈已从算力转移到 GPU 显存与集群通信带宽。现有方案(Megatron 3D 并行、ZeRO/FSDP、专家并行)对所有层施加同一全局并行计划,但 MoE 各组件瓶颈差异巨大——注意力受激活限制、专家 FFN 受权重与路由限制、词表投影产生最大 logit 张量、优化器状态远超权重——单一方案无法在所有组件上 Pareto 最优,导致大量显存与带宽资源闲置。

Method: MoP 包含四项组件专属的并行设计,均保持"rank 级别类数据并行"特性(每 rank 持有不同 token 分片)以共享 W 个 rank 的重叠子组:(1) 稠密权重采用 W 路高效分片(all-gather/reduce-scatter);(2) 注意力激活采用 Ulysses 风格序列并行(D 子组),在注意力块内外分别做序列切分与 head 切分的 all-to-all;(3) 专家权重采用"专家并行 × 补充分片"的混合 EP× 分片,并在其上叠加基于 LLEP 的内存高效变体,通过将路由通信与专家计算重叠来压缩瞬时激活峰值;(4) 词表投影采用 P 子组的"数据-张量并行"分片方案,在不物化 O(NV) 全 logit 张量的前提下精确计算 loss 与梯度(峰值降至 O(NV/P));(5) 优化器状态托管在 host 内存,通过计算-通信重叠的高效流水线进行更新,使更新几乎不出现在关键路径上。所有机制均无损——仅重排计算与通信而不改变结果。

Result: 在 8×H200 节点上对 120B/600B/1T 参数 MoE 从零训练,MoP 在基线可拟合的最长上下文下达到 1043/236/166 tokens/s/GPU,相比 FSDP-best 基线(223/39/25 tokens/s/GPU)分别获得 4.7×/6.1×/6.6× 吞吐提升,1T 模型在 256K 上下文下达到 8.2×;且 MoP 在 64K–128K 以上即 512K、1M 等长上下文下持续训练,而 FSDP 基线均 OOM,吞吐量随上下文增长几乎保持平稳(1T 模型 128K→1M 仅从 166 降至 100 tokens/s/GPU)。每步 wall time 基本由前向/反向计算决定,即使在万亿规模下亦然。

Conclusion: MoP 验证了"按组件匹配并行策略"优于"对所有层施加统一方案"的范式,能够以远小于以往系统的硬件预算实现万亿参数 MoE 在近百万 token 上下文下的无损预训练/微调,是设备显存受限场景(例如在小型集群上对大型 MoE 进行后训练)下带宽-内存权衡的内存效率极端。未来方向包括基于模型形状与集群拓扑自动选择子组大小(D, E_p, P),以及将该组件专属视角推广到长上下文推理。

Abstract: This paper showcases a memory-efficient training stack for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It is a training paradigm that combines and specializes various existing and novel parallelism techniques at different layers and stages of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training pipeline. It leverages these techniques to achieve maximal efficiency given the physical constraints of CPU, CPU memory, GPU HBM memory, and the CPU-GPU, GPU-GPU, and node-node communication bandwidth of the GPU cluster. It also contains a novel strategy for the optimizer step to achieve high throughput and memory efficiency, enabling practitioners to conduct lossless pre-training/fine-tuning of trillion-parameter scale models, at a million context length, with just under 12 8x H200 GPU nodes, with state-of-the-art throughput and memory efficiency. In our experiments, MoP delivers 4.7x--8.2x higher per-GPU throughput than a strongly-tuned FSDP2 baseline (with the gap widening at larger scale) and sustains training at context lengths up to 1M tokens, where the baseline runs out of memory beyond 64--128K.

</details>


### [163] [Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02043)
*Shrikara Arun,Anjaly Parayil,Srikant Bharadwaj,Renee St. Amant,Victor Rühle*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kairos，一个用于解耦式 LLM 推理服务的负载感知预填充（prefill）偏转调度器。Kairos 通过将部分请求的 prefill 阶段以 chunked-prefill 方式偏转至空闲的 decode 节点执行，从而消除 prefill 队列等待和跨节点 KV cache 传输开销。基于 vLLM 实现，在生产级 bursty 负载下可将 P95 TTFT 降低最多 81%，SLO 达成率提升最多 79%，单请求调度开销低于 1ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解耦式 LLM 服务将 prefill 和 decode 分配到独立的 GPU 池，在 bursty、重尾分布负载下出现新不对称性：prefill 节点饱和而 decode 节点计算资源闲置。在 2P2D A100 集群上实证发现 prefill 计算本身仅占 P95 TTFT 的 2-23%，其余 77-98% 来自 prefill 排队和跨节点 KV cache 传输。同时已有静态偏转策略（如基于队列长度或 prompt 长度的阈值）在欠偏转与过偏转之间难以权衡，无法兼顾 TTFT 与 TBT SLO。

Method: Kairos 在 prefill 调度器前增加一层偏转决策层：1) 利用一次性的部署时分析型 step-latency 模型（线性回归，MAPE<10%）预测纯 prefill、纯 decode 和混合 batch 的步骤延迟；2) Prefill-Node TTFT Estimator 基于队列深度和 chunk 大小估算请求若留在 prefill 节点的 TTFT；3) Decode-Node Feasibility Checker 对每个 decode 节点贪心地搜索最大 TBT-safe chunk 调度序列 X=[χ^(1),...,χ^(m)]，其中 T_step(B_n, K_n+Σχ^(j), χ^(i)) ≤ β×τ；4) 当满足 TTFT̂_dec(r,n★,X★) ≤ α·TTFT̂_pf(r) 且不超过 TTFT SLO 时偏转，α=1.3 为单一可调旋钮。系统基于 vLLM 0.18.1 实现，新增约 2000 行 Python 代码，节点状态每 100ms 心跳上报。

Result: 在 Azure A100 集群上以 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 评估，使用 Company X 生产 bursty trace：Kairos 在 P95 TTFT≤4s 与 P95 TBT≤70ms 联合 SLO 下可持续至 9 RPS，而 PD Disaggregation 与 TaiChi 基线在 7 RPS 即破线；P95 TTFT 最高降低 81%，SLO 达成率最高提升 79%（相同 SLO 目标下可持续请求率高 28.5%）；输出 token 吞吐在饱和后也高于两个基线；按设计保证 0% TBT 违规；每请求调度延迟 <1ms。

Conclusion: Kairos 证明了在解耦式 LLM 推理中利用 decode 节点空闲算力执行偏转 prefill 的可行性：通过每请求、状态感知的 TBT-safe chunk 调度搜索，可在不违反 decode SLO 的前提下显著降低尾延迟并提升 SLO 达成率。该工作将"重配置集群拓扑"思路转变为"轻量级、每请求的运行时调度"，对未来解耦式服务系统的调度器设计具有参考价值；其局限在于依赖周期性节点状态（可扩展受限）、未考虑 prefix cache 跨节点驻留、且对长尾 prefix miss 场景需进一步探索。

Abstract: Disaggregated LLM serving runs prefill and decode on separate GPU pools to keep the two phases from interfering. In practice, this creates a new asymmetry: under bursty, heavy-tailed workloads prefill nodes saturate while decode nodes have compute underutilized, and on a production-style A100 cluster with 2 prefill and 2 decode nodes (2P2D), we find that prefill execution accounts for only 2-23% of P95 Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Queuing and inter-node GPU-GPU KV-cache transfer account for the rest. We present a proactive prefill-deflecting scheduler that lets decode nodes serve prefill phase of requests as chunked-prefill steps interleaved with their in-flight decode batches. For each queued request, we estimate the TTFT it would see on the prefill node, and on every decode node, search for the largest chunk schedule that keeps in-flight decodes within their Time-Between-Tokens (TBT) SLO and deflect when the decode path helps tail latency. Because the prefill phase of deflected requests runs in place on the decode node, the inter-node KV transfer is eliminated. Implemented on vLLM and evaluated on production-style traces with DeepSeek-V2-Lite, our approach reduces P95 TTFT by upto 81% and raises SLO attainment by upto 79% over state-of-the-art disaggregated schedulers, at sub-millisecond per-request routing cost.

</details>


### [164] [HYPIC: Accelerating Hybrid-Attention LLM Serving with Position-Independent Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01299)
*Yifei Liu,Juntong Wu,Yang Liu,Junhao Hu,Minghao Li,Xiaoxu Chen,Weihang Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Hypic是首个面向混合注意力（hybrid-attention）大语言模型的位置无关缓存（Position-Independent Caching, PIC）服务系统。它针对线性注意力层提出"段累积转移算子"（segment-cumulative transition operator）以实现常数时间状态组合，针对全注意力层提出"边界缝合窗口"（seam window, w=8）机制修复跨段上下文，并利用段自包含性实现跨实例并行冷预填充，在保证接近全重计算精度的同时显著降低TTFT并提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM服务正从单轮对话转向RAG和Agentic等长上下文场景，这些场景将独立文本片段拼接为长上下文，使prefill成为主导开销。两个并行加速方向——位置无关缓存（PIC）允许非连续片段的KV复用，混合注意力模型通过线性化大部分层降低复杂度——各自有效但无法共存：PIC依赖的逐token KV原语无法迁移到线性注意力的逐请求循环状态；现有全注意力PIC的修正方法也因线性层抑制逐token隐藏状态而失效。此外，长冷请求的串行prefill仍是PDC与现有PIC的尾延迟主要来源。

Method: Hypic包含三项核心贡献：(C1) 识别"段累积转移算子"T_C作为线性注意力PIC的缺失代数原语，将其与每段的零起始终止状态S_{C|0}一同缓存，通过合成律S_{SC₁...Cₙ}=(∏T_{Cᵢ})S_S+∑(∏T_{Cⱼ})S_{Cᵢ|0}实现近精确、常数时间的段间状态组合，覆盖RetNet、Lightning-2、Mamba2、GLA、DeltaNet、GDN、KDA等所有高级线性注意力变体；(C2) 针对混合堆栈中剩余全注意力层，观察到注意力偏差集中于段边界处，提出仅在每个边界重计算w=8 token的缝合窗口即可恢复跨段回溯与注意力sink；(C3) 利用PIC赋予的段自包含性，将单次请求的冷段通过LPT策略分发到多worker并行预填充，由combine节点组装，将冷prefill从O(n·|C|)串行路径降至O(|C|+c)。系统架构包含Hypic Router、Store、Assembler三部分，实现于SGLang（约14k行Python+Triton）。

Result: 在8×H20节点上对4个混合注意力模型（Ring-mini/flash-linear-2.0、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）和5个工作负载（HotpotQA、TriviaQA、MultiNews、GovReport、Prod-RAG生产trace）的评估表明：Hypic相对Full Recompute平均降低TTFT 2.46×、相对Prefix Cache降低2.43×，峰值吞吐量提升最高2.0×，最大加速达8.6×（Qwen3.5-122B/MultiNews）；任务精度损失平均仅3.34分（Naive Addition平均损失25.3分）；缝窗口w=8即可恢复ROUGE-L接近全重计算；冷预填充在8 worker下获得6.1×加速；段组合每多一段仅增2.3ms，TTFT随段数增长近似线性；线性注意力组成在最深层状态漂移保持在10%以内（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B为8.92% L₂/5.11°）。

Conclusion: Hypic首次实现了混合注意力LLM上的位置无关缓存服务，通过段累积转移算子、边界缝合窗口和段并行预填充三项创新解决了PIC与混合架构不兼容的核心难题，显著加速RAG和Agentic工作负载同时保持接近全重计算的精度。该系统证明了PIC与混合注意力架构可以有效结合，为生产环境长上下文LLM服务提供了实用方案；未来工作可关注状态漂移的进一步压缩、更多架构变体支持以及与decode阶段优化的协同设计。

Abstract: In retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and agentic LLM serving, prompts are assembled from independent segments into long contexts, making the prefill stage dominate the per-request computation cost. To this cost, two directions have emerged in parallel: position-independent caching (PIC) admits KV reuse for non-contiguous segments shared across different requests, while hybrid-attention models reduce computation complexity by replacing most full-attention layers with linear attention. However, they cannot coexist: applying PIC to hybrid-attention models breaks down because per-token KV-cache reuse primitives do not transfer to the per-request recurrent state. In this work, we present Hypic, the first serving system for hybrid-attention LLMs with position-independent caching. For linear-attention layers, we identify the segment-cumulative transition operator as the missing algebraic primitive, and cache it alongside each segment's zero-start end-state, enabling near-exact and constant-time state composition of independently cached segments. For the remaining full-attention layers, existing PIC methods also fail as linear layers do not expose the per-token hidden states for selective recomputation. We show that the most significant attention deviation concentrates at segment boundaries, so recomputing only a small seam window at each boundary suffices to restore cross-segment lookback. Finally, Hypic exploits segment-level self-containment to parallelize cache-miss prefill across instances, turning long cold requests -- a major tail-latency contributor under both prefix caching and prior PIC -- into an accelerable workload. Evaluated across four hybrid-attention models and five workloads, Hypic reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 2.45x on average and improves peak throughput by up to 2.0x over existing systems, while staying within 3.3 points of full-recompute accuracy.

</details>


### [165] [SLFS: a Flexible, Low-Cost Distributed File System Using Serverless Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01486)
*Cheng Hao,Yang,Paola Alsharabaty,Soufiane Jounaid,Cristina Nita-Rotaru,Ji-Yong Shin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SLFS是首个完全基于无服务器（serverless）函数构建的分布式文件系统，同时将数据操作和元数据操作都放在无服务器函数上执行。它通过基于键值存储的哈希索引、短生命周期多线程服务器设计、以及策略驱动的协调器，有效缓解冷启动问题，并显著降低成本与提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分布式文件系统（如HDFS、EFS、Ceph）以整台服务器粒度进行伸缩（分钟到小时级），无法应对文件访问负载的快速细粒度波动；运维者按峰值配置导致大量资源在低谷期闲置浪费。无服务器计算提供毫秒级弹性伸缩和按使用付费的定价模型，理论上能很好地匹配文件系统的波动负载，但现有方案（如λFS）只将元数据放在函数中且为缓存元数据而保持函数常驻，丧失了无服务器的真正成本优势。

Method: SLFS的核心设计包括：(1) 基于键值存储的哈希索引，将文件路径和块号直接映射到KV对，避免在函数内维护复杂的inode等元数据结构；(2) 短生命周期多线程服务器式的函数实例设计——函数不处理完一个请求就终止，而是像一台多线程服务器一样短时存活并并发处理多个请求，从而诱发"热启动"并保持实例忙碌；(3) 策略驱动的协调器（coordinator），负责文件到函数的映射、函数生命周期控制、负载均衡与弹性伸缩，并采用控制流与数据流分离以避免协调器成为瓶颈；(4) 面向对象式的设计：每个文件/目录映射到专用函数实例，实现隔离、并发控制和写穿透LRU缓存；(5) 基于键值后端的软更新与两阶段提交混合机制保证一致性与多文件原子性（如rename）；(6) 灵活的存储后端，可运行于S3、Cassandra或自研的Primitive Storage Backend (PSB，基于LevelDB+链式复制)之上。

Result: 基于OpenWhisk+Docker在云上部署，使用Azure Functions BLOB数据集等多种负载进行评估：(1) 冷/热启动方面，SLFS相比默认无服务器设计最多减少580×的冷/暖启动，与λFS热启动次数相当但函数调用成本低21×；(2) 元数据更新性能上，SLFS可达约20 Kops/s，而λFS仅不到1 Kops/s（受限于MySQL Cluster NDB）；(3) 端到端性能上，SLFS平均比EFS快4.19×，比Ceph在写密集和混合负载下快2.42×–23.73×；(4) 成本方面，SLFS比λFS便宜48%–63%，比EFS便宜12%–68%，性价比（Ceph为2.09×–2.72×；写吞吐缓存平均提升22.68%；可在不同KV后端（S3、Cassandra、自研PSB）之间灵活权衡成本与性能。

Conclusion: SLFS证明了用无服务器函数同时承载文件数据与元数据服务的可行性。其短生命周期多线程服务器式的函数实例设计有效缓解了冷/暖启动问题，策略驱动的协调器在性能与成本间取得平衡，基于键值存储的哈希索引保证了简单性与可移植性。SLFS在性能与成本上均显著优于λFS、AWS EFS和Ceph，为云原生文件系统提供了一种可弹性伸缩、成本可控、可灵活选择存储后端的新方案。

Abstract: Large-scale distributed file systems must provision resources for peak demand, yet file access patterns fluctuate significantly, leaving substantial capacity idle during off-peak periods. Existing scaling mechanisms operate at the granularity of entire servers and take minutes to hours, making them unable to track the rapid, fine-grained load variations that file systems commonly experience. Serverless computing, with its millisecond-granularity elasticity and pay-per-use pricing, offers a compelling alternative. We present SLFS, the first distributed file system built with serverless functions for both data and metadata operations. SLFS implements file services on top of key-value stores, keeping function operations simple and short, and introduces a novel multi-threaded, short-lived server design that overcomes the cold-start problem while maintaining low cost. A policy-enforcing coordinator efficiently maps files to function instances, scales the system elastically, and controls function lifetimes to balance performance and cost. SLFS can flexibly run on diverse storage backends -- from cloud-native services like S3 to user-managed key-value stores -- enabling configurable cost-performance trade-offs. Our evaluation shows that SLFS mitigates cold starts by 580$\times$ compared to the base serverless design and outperforms $\lambda$FS, EFS, and Ceph at up to 63%, 68%, and 63% lower cost, respectively.

</details>


### [166] [OmniPilot: An Uncertainty-Aware LLM Inference Advisor for Heterogeneous GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01579)
*D. Balamurugan,Thomas W. Bush*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OmniPilot 是一个面向异构 GPU 集群的 LLM 推理启动建议器。它通过共形校准的分位数代价模型预测吞吐、延迟、显存与功耗,并在请求超出其测量支持域时主动弃权(不给出建议);最终按操作员的"经济效用"对配置(GPU 类型、张量并行度、量化精度)进行排序推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享异构 GPU 集群上部署 LLM 推理前,用户必须预先选择 GPU 类型、张量并行(TP)度和数值精度,而这些选择代价高昂:在作者的 561 次基准测试中有 14%(80 次)直接因硬件不兼容或显存溢出而失败;静态"一刀切"部署方案忽略了复杂交互——量化效果因模型族而异、KV 缓存压力带来尺寸-精度权衡、TP 度增加会显著降低启动成功率;传统调度器(Slurm)只记录资源占用方式而非具体工作负载行为,无法支撑吞吐预测;因此需要一个在提交前给出带校准不确定性建议并在域外主动弃权的预提交建议器。

Method: 1) 在 log 空间拟合一组梯度提升分位数回归器(分位点 {0.1, 0.5, 0.9}),覆盖 8 个目标(6 个决策驱动:聚合 tokens/s、请求吞吐、TTFT p50、冷启动时间、KV 缓存峰值、平均功耗;2 个仅诊断:SM 与 Tensor Core 活跃度);约 28 维特征,含 9 个模型族、5 种 GPU、4 种量化的一-hot 编码;2) 用分块共形(GroupKFold)在 log 空间做加性偏移校准(CQR),恢复 80% 覆盖率;3) 用"支持距离"作为域外(OOD)弃权层,记录 7 个轴的训练包络,推理时检测越界即降级为低置信度;4) 决策层按经济效用排序:效用 = 价值/令牌 × 吞吐 × 运行时间 − 算力成本 − 排队等待 − 期望失败成本 − SLO 违约成本 − KV 饱和惩罚(拐点 0.85);5) 启动成功率先验由集群 Slurm 数据用 beta-二项估计向池化率收缩得到;6) 用 GroupKFold(按 workload cell 分组)做无泄漏回测,并以回归门控(retraining loop)限制目标 MAPE 不退化超过 0.5 个百分点。

Result: 在 460 行冻结快照上,聚合吞吐 MAPE=6.2%、log 空间 R²=0.92,TTFT/请求吞吐 MAPE 7.6–12%,R² 0.92–0.93;联合放置决策(65 个多臂 cell)在成本敏感价值点下达到 95% top-1 准确率、平均效用遗憾仅 0.003,显著优于 H100/FP8 固定配方(42% top-1、遗憾 1.65)与吞吐最大化策略(3% top-1、遗憾 4.73);在 476 行扩展集(66 cell)上仍保持 92% top-1、遗憾 0.006;OOD 5 个 holdout cell 误差飙升至 24–46%,共形区间覆盖 0/5,但支持距离弃权层成功将全部 5 个标记为低置信度;KV 饱和项的加入使 Qwen2.5-32B/A100 cell 的精度决策无需新增数据即得到修正(该 cell 遗憾由 0.28 下降,精度 backtest 准确率升至 96%);固定任务学习曲线显示约 150 行后收益递减,R² 由 0.37(25 行)升至 0.79(360 行);集群层面还得到一个负面结果:Slurm 元数据无法支撑集群级吞吐建议器,仅能用作需求与启动成功率先验。

Conclusion: OmniPilot 证明:在共享异构 GPU 集群上,将硬件配置选择重构为带校准不确定性的经济决策是可行且高效的,可在不增加数据的情况下将放置遗憾降低超过一个数量级;但其安全性依赖于"共形区间 + 支持距离弃权"两层防护——单一共形区间在域外失效,因此必须配套 OOD 弃权;研究还提炼出三条方法论教训:新轴必须先在特征工程中表达再收集数据(特征先于数据)、许多预测错误应通过效用设计与测量精度而非模型容量解决、调度器元数据不足以替代工作负载级遥测;未来工作将扩展到训练与故障恢复负载、多节点推理服务、纵向漂移研究,以及实现能更新后验均值的基准门控。

Abstract: Serving large language models (LLMs) on a shared, heterogeneous GPU cluster requires users and operators to select the GPU type, tensor-parallel degree, and precision before committing valuable node-hours. Making these choices is challenging because effective throughput, launch-success rates, and cluster demand and utilization continuously fluctuate. Furthermore, static configuration recipes miss critical interactions: quantization effects depend heavily on the model family, key-value cache pressure creates size-by-precision trade-offs, and failure rates vary by more than twofold across different tensor-parallel degrees. Additionally, cluster resources are frequently constrained by unpredictable hardware failures. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{OmniPilot}, a launch advisor that predicts serving costs for feasible configurations and abstains when requests fall outside its measured support envelope. OmniPilot pairs a conformally calibrated quantile cost model (spanning eight serving targets) with an out-of-distribution (OOD) abstention layer. It ranks configurations using an economic utility metric calibrated to an operator's revealed preferences. In evaluations across 460 benchmark runs on A100, H100, and H200 hardware across four precisions, OmniPilot predicts aggregate throughput with a 6.2\% mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) and a log-space $R^2=0.92$. The advisor achieves 95\% top-1 accuracy with a mean utility regret of just 0.003. When tested on an OOD holdout of unsupported cells, prediction error climbs to 24-46\% and conformal intervals cover 0 of 5 points; however, the abstention layer successfully flags all five as low-confidence. Over time, these OOD scenarios will be integrated into the training dataset to continuously expand the advisor's support envelope.

</details>


### [167] [Arachne: Orchestrating Cascades for Efficient Text-to-Video Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01701)
*Peng Yu,Yuankai Fan,Yang Qiu,Tian Li,Bihuan Chen,Yin Chen,Qizhen Weng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Arachne是一个面向大规模文本到视频(T2V)模型训练的高效分布式训练框架，通过将训练过程分解为细粒度的"级联"(cascades)计算单元，并对其在集群上的执行进行时空协同编排，将迭代时间较现有主流框架(Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed、FlexSP)最高减少65%，且性能优势随训练规模扩大而增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2V模型在异构视频数据(不同分辨率和时长)上训练时，传统的分桶(bucketing)策略配合静态数据并行(DP)与序列并行(SP)会导致严重的负载不均衡和GPU空闲(例如同一迭代中处理113帧的rank耗时58.6秒而处理13帧的rank仅需6.0秒)。已有的LLM领域动态并行方法(如FlexSP)聚焦于通信开销，无法解决T2V中计算密集型DiT架构下的计算瓶颈问题，亟需一种能同时打破"空间静态绑定"与"时间严格同步"双重刚性的编排机制。

Method: Arachne将每个训练样本分解为细粒度、可独立调度的"级联"(cascade)，每个cascade封装数据、模型模块、并行策略和GPU分配等配置。其系统由三个协同组件组成：(1) 级联级并行规划器：基于MILP建模级联间DAG依赖，最小化makespan，并采用遗传算法作为可接受的启发式求解器；(2) 拓扑感知资源映射器：通过四级优先级层次(节点内→均衡跨节点→NIC对齐→NUMA感知的intra-cascade放置，以及与数据交接协同的inter-cascade放置)将逻辑计划映射到物理GPU布局；(3) 运行时执行器：实现自适应级联间数据交接(就地交接/异步多broker机制)以及面向异构梯度累积的两阶段代表集同步原语。同时为VAE和DiT分别构建了层次化(模拟+XGBoost残差拟合)与解析式(线性+二次自注意力+通信带宽)的成本模型。

Result: 在64块H100-80GB集群上的评估显示：基于Open-Sora课程在WebVid/Koala/Lynx三阶段数据上训练HunyuanVideo-13B时，Arachne较Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed、FlexSP在Stage 3(1080p)分别取得最高65%、59%、35%的迭代时间缩减，GPU空闲率从基线的33.6%降至8.1%。可扩展性方面，模型规模从1.3B增至13B时相对Megatron的加速从35%提升至43%；工作负载异构性增大(最大帧窗口53→105)时加速从21%提升至35%；集群规模从16扩展至64 GPU时稳定保持30%–40%的吞吐优势。消融实验表明拓扑感知资源映射器贡献最高(Stage 3去除后慢19.26%)，其中intra-cascade放置策略(13.67%)远重要于inter-cascade(3.64%)。案例分析显示per-rank TFLOPS的CV显著降低且跨50次迭代保持时间稳定性。

Conclusion: Arachne通过细粒度时空协同编排范式，突破了静态并行在数据异构性下的双重刚性约束，在大规模T2V训练场景下实现了显著且随规模放大的效率提升；其将"数据异构性"转化为"更丰富的调度机会"的设计理念，为未来更大规模生成式模型训练提供了可扩展、面向生产环境的解决方案，作者承诺将开源完整实现及训练负载。

Abstract: The rising demand for AI-generated videos is fueled by advances in large-scale Text-to-Video (T2V) models, trained on extensive datasets of video clips spanning diverse resolutions and durations. To address this data heterogeneity, current training methods often use a bucketing strategy that groups samples into discrete buckets for efficiency. However, this approach struggles to scale with compute and data volumes under static parallelism schemes, such as data and sequence parallelism, leading to significant workload imbalances and hardware under-utilization. In this paper, we present Arachne, a novel training framework for efficient T2V model training at scale. Arachne decomposes the training process into fine-grained computational units, called \textit{cascades}, orchestrating their distributed execution and synchronization across the cluster through coordinated spatial and temporal optimization. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that Arachne reduces iteration time by up to 65\% over leading frameworks, exhibiting a positive scaling trend where its performance advantages amplify as training scale grows.

</details>


### [168] [Exploiting Task-Based Parallelism for the Red-Black Gauss-Seidel Method on 2D Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01735)
*Shiting Long,Gustavo Ramirez-Hidalgo,Andreas Frommer,Dirk Pleiter*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对二维泊松方程的红黑Gauss-Seidel迭代求解器，对比了基于任务（task-based）的OpenMP task和OmpSs-2两种并行实现与经典fork-join模式（OpenMP parallel for）的性能差异。研究表明，OmpSs-2凭借NUMA感知调度在x86（JUWELS）和Arm（HAICGU）平台上均能达到与甚至超过parallel for的性能，并在高核心数、多NUMA域的Arm平台上表现出更高的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多核处理器中，并行性能提升日益依赖任务分解而非主频提升。传统分治（fork-join）策略在多色Gauss-Seidel等算法中面临全局同步开销大、负载不均衡、对硬件异步性容忍度低等问题。以往研究多认为任务模型对规则工作负载收益有限，本文旨在重新评估任务并行模型在规则stencil类应用中的有效性，并探究其对架构级异步性的适应能力。

Method: 1. 基准问题：二维泊松方程5点stencil离散，红黑Gauss-Seidel迭代。2. 三种实现：① OpenMP parallel for（基线，fork-join）；② OpenMP task，通过depend子句声明数据依赖；③ OmpSs-2，使用Nanos6运行时，支持NUMA感知调度。3. 数据划分：沿一维将网格划分为nb个水平条带，每块更新为一个任务，每迭代发出2·nb个任务。4. 评估平台：JUWELS（2×Intel Xeon 8168，48核，2 NUMA域）和HAICGU（2×Kunpeng 920，128核，4 NUMA域）。5. 利用roofline模型（arithmetic intensity ≈ 0.29，属memory-bound）估算可达性能上限。6. 采用Extrae/Ovni+Paraver进行执行轨迹分析。

Result: 1. OmpSs-2因NUMA感知支持，在两平台上均优于OpenMP task；若禁用NUMA特性，性能分别下降约40%（JUWELS）和43%（HAICGU）。2. 在JUWELS上，OmpSs-2与parallel for性能相当；缓存缺失率（L2/L3）实测几乎相同，说明cache复用差异不显著。3. 在HAICGU上，OmpSs-2性能高于parallel for且更稳定（box-plot变异性更小），可归因于动态调度可隐藏线程执行延迟，避免fork-join屏障处的空闲等待。4. 执行轨迹显示：parallel for存在明显的红/黑阶段分隔与屏障间隙；OmpSs-2的红色与黑色任务在时间上可部分重叠，连续迭代间也能交叠，核心持续忙碌。5. 任务粒度nb为新增调参参数，需经验调优以避免欠用或过用。

Conclusion: 对于规则stencil类应用，任务并行模型（尤其是具备NUMA感知的OmpSs-2）能与传统parallel for在性能上匹敌甚至更优，同时对架构异步性具有更强的鲁棒性。任务模型的实现复杂度与parallel for相近，远低于用MPI实现同等细粒度并行的开销。未来工作将扩展到高维问题、更复杂的多色Gauss-Seidel变体以及其他奇偶型迭代方法。

Abstract: Gauss-Seidel is a well-established iterative method for the solution of linear systems, and multicoloring has been widely used to increase parallelism in iterative solution techniques. Implementing multi-color Gauss-Seidel with conventional divide-and-conquer parallelization strategies, however, may be inefficient due to global synchronization requirements and load imbalances. Task-based programming models can mitigate these issues by enabling fine-grained parallelism, removing global barriers and allowing updates of different colors to partially overlap in time. In this work, we implement the red-black Gauss-Seidel method using two task-based programming models and compare them with a classical divide-and-conquer parallel implementation to evaluate the impact of fine-grained parallelism on execution efficiency. The red-black scheme serves as a representative example, as task-based approaches naturally extend to more general multi-color schemes arising from unstructured grids and wider stencils. Using the solve of the 2D Poisson equation as benchmark, our results show that task-based implementations can achieve performance comparable to conventional divide-and-conquer parallelization while providing greater resilience to hardware-level asynchronicity.

</details>


### [169] [HCMS: Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline for Communication-Computation Overlap in Long-Sequence Parallel Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01817)
*Chao Yuan,Pan Li,Yingnan Sun,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 HCMS（Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline），通过将多头注意力的头维度划分为多个独立块，并利用双 CUDA 流实现通信与计算的细粒度流水线重叠，在不修改底层注意力内核的前提下显著加速基于 all-to-all 的序列并行注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 all-to-all 的序列并行方案（如 DeepSpeed Ulysses）在中等长度序列（31K-100K tokens，例如视频生成场景）下，通信与计算严格串行执行，导致硬件资源利用率低下。在 4-8 GPU PCIe 配置下通信占比 ρ 通常达 15%-40%，存在显著优化空间。现有方法各有局限：Ring Attention 需 P-1 轮串行通信且块级重叠粒度受限；Ulysses 原始实现完全无重叠；基于 tile 的重叠方法需修改底层内核，兼容性差。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) Head Chunking 策略——利用多头注意力计算的独立性（Property 1 和 Lemma 1），将 H 个注意力头划分为 C 个独立块，使不同块之间的通信和计算可独立调度，支持不均匀划分且保持数值等价；(2) 双流流水线架构——通信流 S_comm 专责 all-to-all 集合通信，计算流 S_comp 专责注意力计算，通过三个阶段（输入通信→注意力计算→输出通信）实现流水线执行；(3) CUDA Event 同步机制——使用 E_c^comm 和 E_c^comp 事件精确管理块间数据依赖。理论分析推导出最优块数 C*=√(T_comm/β) 和加速比上界 S_max=1/(1-ρ)，并指出 ρ>20% 时推荐使用。

Result: 在四种 GPU 平台（L20/4090/A10/5090）、2-8 GPU 规模、31K-56K tokens 视频生成长度下，HCMS 较 Ulysses 基准实现 10%-17.5% 加速，较 Ring Attention 实现 5%-14.5% 加速；在 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 模型上注意力层达 18.3% 加速，端到端达 6.8% 加速。消融实验表明 C=4-5 时性能最优，不均匀划分性能差异<1%，前向+反向联合训练达 3.5% 加速且峰值内存降低 8.7%。理论模型预测误差<1.4%，加速比与通信比 ρ 正相关。

Conclusion: HCMS 通过头维度的细粒度分块和双流流水线，有效解决了序列并行注意力中通信-计算串行执行的资源浪费问题。其正交兼容性（兼容 FlashAttention/SDPA，无需修改内核）、不均匀划分支持、训练兼容性及跨平台泛化能力使其具有较高实用价值。局限在于计算密集型场景（ρ<10%）收益有限，且过大的 C 值会带来事件同步开销累积。Future work 将扩展至 16 GPU 及跨节点场景，并探索反向传播梯度通信重叠及自适应 C 值调度。

Abstract: All-to-all based sequence parallelism methods execute communication and computation strictly in serial when processing medium-long sequences, resulting in hardware resource underutilization. This paper proposes Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline (HCMS), which exploits the computational independence of multi-head attention by partitioning attention heads into multiple chunks and achieving fine-grained communication-computation overlap through dual CUDA streams. HCMS is orthogonally compatible with existing optimizations such as FlashAttention and SDPA, requires no modification to underlying kernels, supports uneven partitioning while maintaining numerical equivalence. Experiments validate the effectiveness across four GPU platforms at 2-8 GPU scales: for typical video generation sequence lengths of 31K-56K tokens, HCMS achieves 10\%-17.5\% speedup over the Ulysses baseline and 5\%-14.5\% speedup over Ring Attention; end-to-end acceleration of 6.8\% is achieved on the Wan2.2 model. Theoretical analysis shows that HCMS benefits are positively correlated with communication ratio $\rho$, and its use is recommended when $\rho>20\%$.

</details>


### [170] [Lynx: Progressive Speculative Quantization for accelerating KV Transfer in Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01831)
*Wenchen Han,Gingfung Matthew Yeung,Marco Barletta,William Toner,Amory Hoste,Adam Barker*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Lynx是一种用于LLM分离式推理（disaggregated inference）的渐进式KV缓存传输系统，通过将KV缓存按位重要性拆分为高优先级Anchor流（最高有效位）和低优先级Residual流（剩余精度），实现边接收边解码的推测式执行，在保持BF16精度的同时将TTFT提升至接近4-bit量化的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理在分离式LLM推理中需要跨网络传输巨大的KV缓存，解码必须等传输完成才能开始。现有的KV量化方案无法同时实现低网络延迟和高推理精度，论文挑战"KV缓存必须作为一个不可分割整体接收后才能使用"这一假设。

Method: 1. 利用KV缓存不同位对注意力贡献不均的观察：最高有效位捕获注意力的粗粒度结构，最低有效位精化精度。2. 设计Lynx系统，将KV缓存按位拆分为Anchor流（MSB，高优先级）和Residual流（剩余位，低优先级）。3. 采用渐进式分流传输（progressive split-stream transfer），解码在收到Anchor流后立即开始。4. 推测式执行：Residual流传输期间继续解码，最后通过verification机制确保与高精度解码结果一致。

Result: 在多个模型和推理负载上的实验表明：Lynx的TTFT与激进的4-bit KV量化相当，但精度匹配BF16高精度推理；相比标准8-bit KV量化的TTFT提升最高达1.43倍；相比现有最优方法（state-of-the-art）精度提升最高达5.1%。

Conclusion: Lynx通过按重要性优先级的渐进式KV缓存传输设计，突破了KV缓存作为整体传输的范式，在不牺牲推理精度的前提下显著降低首Token时间，验证了"位级非均匀重要性"在实际推理系统中的可利用价值。

Abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly common in large language model (LLM) serving, driven by retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. In disaggregated inference, these workloads require transferring large Key-Value (KV) caches across the network, where decoding cannot begin until the transfer completes. Recent KV quantization techniques reduce data volume and alleviate this bottleneck, but existing schemes fail to achieve both low network-exposed latency and high inference accuracy. We challenge the assumption that the KV cache is an indivisible unit that must be fully received before use. We leverage the observation that different bits in the KV cache contribute unequally to attention computation and inference precision: the most significant bits capture the coarse structure of attention and the least significant bits refine precision. This property enables partial use of the KV cache during decoding. We present Lynx, a system that enables progressive, split-stream KV transfer by partitioning the KV cache into a high-priority Anchor stream carrying the most significant bits and a low-priority Residual stream carrying remaining precision. Decoding begins upon receipt of the Anchor stream and proceeds speculatively while the Residual stream is transferred concurrently, followed by verification that ensures equivalence to higher-precision decoding. Across multiple models and serving workloads, Lynx achieves Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) comparable to aggressive 4-bit KV quantization, while matching the accuracy of high-precision (BF16) inference, improving TTFT over standard 8-bit KV quantization by up to $1.43\times$ and improving accuracy over state-of-the-art by up to $5.1\%$.

</details>


### [171] [Cadence: Extreme Pipelining with Multiple Concurrent Proposers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02275)
*Fatima Elsheimy,Mohammad Mussadiq Jalalzai,Tobias Klenze,Jovan Komatovic,Mike Setrin,Victor Shoup,Kushal Babel,Lioba Heimbach,Jason Milionis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Cadence 是一种拜占庭容错（BFT）多提议者共识协议，具有极低出块间隔、最优弹性（n=3f+1）和最优快速路径延迟。它通过"极限流水线"将出块间隔与网络延迟解耦，并引入多并发提议者机制（MCP），在快速路径延迟对标单领导者协议的同时，提供短期抗审查性与隐藏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单领导者区块链共识存在两大痛点：(1) 出块间隔受网络延迟制约，限制吞吐量；(2) 单一领导者垄断交易排序与包含权，易产生审查与抢跑问题。如何在保证最优延迟的同时，实现去中心化的多提议者机制，并确保抗审查性与提议隐藏性（hiding）是亟待解决的难题。

Method: 核心方法包括三部分：(1) 极限流水线——将时间划分为等距时隙，每时隙一个独立共识实例，块不直接构建于前驱之上，从而解耦出块间隔与网络延迟；(2) 通用多镜头框架——将满足"时隙共识规范"的任意一次性共识转换为多镜头协议；(3) 两个关键组件——Chorus（时隙共识，快速路径 3 轮即可敲定，提前 1 轮给出推测性敲定）与 Conductor（调度器，按固定节奏开启时隙，异步时放慢节奏以限制开放时隙数）。

Result: 在 Monad 200 个验证者、每时隙 5 个提议者的仿真中：平均敲定时间 219 ms，推测性敲定 167 ms；100 ms 出块间隔下，交易平均仅需等待 50 ms 即可进入提议。理论上证明了在部分同步下满足安全性、活性、抗审查性与隐藏性，且弹性达到最优（n=3f+1）。据作者所知，Cadence 是首个在快速路径延迟上对标单领导者协议的同时提供短期抗审查性与隐藏性的 MCP 协议。

Conclusion: Cadence 在 BFT 共识中同时实现了极低出块间隔、最优延迟、最优弹性以及多提议者环境下的抗审查与隐藏特性，突破了此前 MCP 协议在延迟上的局限，为高性能去中心化区块链底层共识提供了新范式。

Abstract: We present Cadence, a Byzantine fault-tolerant multi-proposer consensus protocol with arbitrarily low block intervals, optimal resilience, and optimal fast-path latency. Cadence divides time into equally spaced slots, one block per slot, each finalized in its own consensus instance. Blocks do not build directly on their predecessor, so instances run independently and none waits for an earlier block to finish or propagate; we call this extreme pipelining, decoupling the block interval from network latency. Cadence also removes the single-leader monopoly over transaction inclusion and ordering: under multiple concurrent proposers (MCP), several validators propose for each block, and it guarantees that, under synchrony, a transaction a correct proposer includes cannot be censored or deferred (short-term censorship resistance), and that no proposer can craft its proposal in reaction to the others' (hiding). To realize extreme pipelining, we introduce a general framework that turns any one-shot consensus meeting our slot-consensus specification into a multi-shot protocol. We instantiate it for MCP with two protocols of our own: Chorus, a slot consensus whose fast path finalizes a block in an optimal three rounds, with speculative finality one round earlier, and Conductor, an orchestrator that opens slots at an even cadence, more slowly under asynchrony to keep open slots bounded. To our knowledge, Cadence is the first MCP protocol to provide short-term censorship resistance and hiding at the fast-path latency of single-leader consensus. We prove safety, liveness, censorship resistance, and hiding under partial synchrony with optimal resilience (n = 3f+1). In simulation over Monad's 200 validators with five proposers per slot, finalization averages 219 ms (167 ms to speculative finality); at a 100 ms block interval a transaction waits on average 50 ms to enter a proposal.

</details>


### [172] [Securing People and their Machines Against Major Faults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02304)
*Ohad Eitan,Idit Keidar,Ehud Shapiro*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向"草根平台"(grassroots platforms)的对等恢复框架,通过身份托管者(state custodians)、状态托管者(state custodians)和社会图三重机制,保护用户免受私钥丢失(身份损失)和智能手机丢失(状态损失)等重大故障的影响。研究将社会图规范为带守卫的多主体原子事务,并通过通信意愿主体(CVA)模型实现,证明该实现在可恢复故障下对应规范运行的正确性,并将该框架推广至草根货币与债券,实现货币日志的精确恢复且无双重支付。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 草根平台(去中心化社交网络、加密货币等)由用户及其个人设备(智能手机)组成,无中央权威或全局基础设施可依赖。当用户丢失私钥(身份损失)或丢失设备(状态损失)时,若没有可靠的恢复机制,平台状态将无法维持。集中式平台可通过全球资源解决此问题,但草根平台必须依赖基于对等节点的恢复方案。本文旨在填补这一空白,为草根平台提供形式化的故障恢复理论基础。

Method: 1) 形式化框架:采用带守卫的多主体原子事务(guarded multiagent atomic transactions)作为规范层,每个代理由"人-机"组成,事务由人的意愿守卫;2) 通信意愿主体(CVA)作为实现层,采用最终同步的消息传递模型,包含 discover、communicate、advance-date 和平台特定事务四类;3) 三层恢复架构:社会图(基础层,提供身份与友谊恢复)、身份托管者(身份创建时指定,需超多数授权方可更换密钥)、状态托管者(平台特定,如货币托管者);4) 关键协议技术:友谊状态用 epoch 计数器奇偶编码、周期性 checkpoint 广播实现状态恢复、Replace 瀑布协议(Vouch→Announce new identity→Rebind)实现身份替换、状态托管者超多数交集实现货币日志精确恢复;5) 故障模型:仅考虑崩溃故障,无私钥泄露后的恶意行为(除身份盗窃外)。

Result: 主要定理包括:定理 4.10——安全社会图是社会图的实现(在无故障情况下);定理 4.11——在友谊保持运行下,安全社会图是社会图的故障弹性实现;定理 6.1——CVA 实现在静止状态下对应安全社会图规范;推论 6.2——CVA 实现安全地实现社会图;定理 7.1(静止对应)、定理 7.3(精确恢复)、推论 7.4(无意外双重支付)、定理 7.5(支付活性)。文章还证明所有协议均满足草根本质(无中央控制、跨子集可独立运行并可合并)。安全图协议具有多项安全性质(好友列表合理性、地址可达性)和活性保证(友谊建立、好友可见性、解好友传播)。

Conclusion: 本文成功构建了草根平台重大故障恢复的统一形式化框架。社会图作为基础平台,承载身份并恢复身份;每个上层平台(如货币)只需添加自身状态的恢复机制,通过状态托管者实现精确恢复。该方案不依赖全局资源,完全基于对等节点的协作,具有草根性、可证明的安全性和活性,以及隐私保护特性(托管者持有好友状态但无法访问)。该框架为去中心化系统中的身份与状态管理提供了理论基础,对区块链钱包社交恢复等实际应用具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: We consider grassroots platforms -- distributed systems of agents consisting of people identified by self-chosen public keys and their machines (smartphones) -- and wish to make them secure against \emph{major faults}: the loss of their private keys and/or their smartphones. As grassroots platforms have no global resource to rely on for recovery, our peer-based solution is based on: (\ia) \emph{a grassroots social graph} in which agents establish and maintain friendships; (\ib) \emph{identity custodians}, designated by each person, and (\ic) \emph{state custodians}, which are grassroots platform-specific. Upon a person experiencing identity loss, and given a willing supermajority of the identity custodians of the person, the friends of the person replace the old public key with the new one across the graph and restore friendships, where all friends serve as state custodians for the social graph. Choosing a new keypair, obtaining a new smartphone, and convincing identity custodians to will a change of key all happen ``off-chain''. Recovery from machine loss without loss of key (e.g. smartphone run over by truck, or its memory wiped) is simpler, requiring only the help of state custodians. We specify the social graph and its secure version as guarded multiagent atomic transactions, and implement the secure social graph via communicating volitional agents, an eventually synchronous message-passing model one step closer to implementation. We prove the implementation maps runs with recoverable faults to correct runs of the specification. We follow a similar path for grassroots coins and bonds, showing a common core as well as the platform-specific aspects of state recovery: a currency's single-writer log is recovered exactly, the recovered sovereign resuming without double-spending.

</details>


### [173] [Elasticity in Parallel Sparse Triangular Solve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02324)
*Raphael S. Steiner,Christos K. Matzoros,Pál András Papp,Toni Böhnlein,A. N. Yzelman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出将陈旧同步并行（Stale Synchronous Parallel, SSP）执行模型首次应用于并行稀疏三角求解（SpTrSV），并设计了一种面向一般有向无环图（DAG）的调度器 ElasticDivide。该调度器能够生成陈旧度为 2 的 SSP 调度表，通过重叠同步与计算来减少同步开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏三角求解（SpTrSV）是科学与工程计算中广泛使用的基本操作（如 LU、QR、Cholesky 分解及迭代法预处理等），但其细粒度依赖和负载不均导致难以高效并行化。现有的同步调度器（如 HDagg、GrowLocal）受限于频繁的同步开销，而异步调度器（如 SpMP）虽然减少了同步次数但调度质量与可移植性受限。尤其在非一致性内存访问（NUMA）架构中，同步成本高昂，如何让计算与同步重叠是性能提升的关键瓶颈。

Method: 1. 形式化定义：陈旧同步并行调度（staleness s），推广自批量同步并行（BSP），允许核心在超步索引差不超过 s 的范围内推进计算。2. ElasticDivide 调度器：基于 GrowLocal 扩展，针对 staleness=2 的情况，通过两条关键创新实现：(i) 跨核依赖解析延迟，使信息需经过多个超步才能被另一核使用；(ii) 平衡当前与下一超步的顶点分配。算法按超步依次分配可分配顶点（Rule I）并按核心独占性与最小 ID 优先排序（Rule II），通过评分函数 β 衡量分配质量，指数式增长 α 以兼顾负载均衡与独立计算。3. 弱（fuzzy）屏障实现：将 arrive 与 wait 操作分离，采用每核独立标志位与本地缓存机制，结合单一计数器统一所有屏障，支持陈旧度下的同步-计算重叠。4. 评测：在 ARM Kunpeng、AMD EPYC、Intel Xeon 三种架构上，使用 SuiteSparse、Eigen 不完全 Cholesky、METIS 嵌套剖分三套数据集，对比 ElasticDivide、GrowLocal、SpMP、HDagg 的性能、扩展性、同步次数、调度时间与摊销成本。

Result: 1. 性能：在 ARM 48 核上，ElasticDivide 相比同步调度器 GrowLocal 的几何平均加速比为 7%-30%；在 x86 48 核上相比 SpMP 加速比为 19%-60%。2. 同步-计算重叠：SSP 相对 BSP 的几何平均加速在 ARM Kunpeng 96 核上可达 4.51×，x86 EPYC 128 核上达 2.19×，NUMA 域数越多提升越显著。3. 同步次数：ElasticDivide 的同步屏障数归一化后与 GrowLocal 相当（0.85×–1.28×），且其同步为弱屏障。4. 调度时间：ElasticDivide 调度时间为 GrowLocal 的一半，摊销成本介于 12–25 之间，远低于 HDagg（最高 2820），仅次于 SpMP（5–10）。5. 扩展性：在 64 核 ARM Kunpeng 上达 20.00× 加速（Metis 数据集），但当并行度在约 80 核附近耗尽时性能出现下降。

Conclusion: 本文证明稀疏三角系统的细粒度依赖图具有足够的弹性以适应陈旧同步并行调度，且无需显著增加同步事件数。陈旧同步并行通过重叠同步与计算，在 NUMA 架构上可获得 10%–30% 的稳定性能提升，在高同步开销场景下甚至可达 100%–350%。所提出的 ElasticDivide 调度器在 ARM 架构上全面优于现有最优调度器，在 x86 上亦具竞争力，且算法思想可直接推广至 GPU 等加速器以掩盖跨设备延迟。

Abstract: We introduce stale synchronous parallel as a mode of execution in parallel sparse triangular linear system solve and present a general directed-acyclic-graph scheduler capable of producing such schedules. Stale-synchronous-parallel schedules allow the overlap of synchronisation and compute which results in a geometric-mean speed-up of $7$-$30\%$ of our scheduler, ElasticDivide, over state-of-the-art synchronous scheduler GrowLocal on an ARM machine using 48 cores. On an x86 machine using 48 cores, we report geometric-mean speed-ups of $19$-$60\%$ over SpMP.

</details>


### [174] [WattGPU: Predicting Inference Power and Latency on Unseen GPUs and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02391)
*Mauricio Fadel Argerich,Jonathan Fürst,Marta Patiño-Martínez*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: WattGPU 提出了两个基于公开元数据的预测模型，用于在无需实际硬件访问或性能剖析的情况下，预测 LLM 推理在 GPU 上的平均功耗和词间延迟（ITL），并首次在未见过的 GPU 和 LLM 上进行了严格验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理在数据中心能耗中占比快速增长，但中小规模部署运营商缺乏将 LLM 与 GPU 进行能效匹配的工具。现有预测方法依赖实际性能剖析数据，且无法泛化到训练时未见过的新硬件。WattGPU 旨在仅利用公开可得的 LLM 元数据和 GPU 规格，就能预测推理功耗和延迟，从而支持能效最优的部署决策。

Method: 构建两个 XGBoost 梯度提升回归模型：1) 功耗模型预测平均 GPU 功耗 $\bar{P}$，目标值通过除以 TDP 进行归一化以学习尺度无关的功耗行为；2) 延迟模型预测 ITL。特征全部来自公开数据：GPU 规格（基础频率、显存带宽、晶体管数、FP16 TFLOPS 等）和 LLM 元数据（参数量、层数、注意力头数、隐藏层大小等），并工程化构建三个衍生特征（Boosting Ratio、Bandwidth Latency、Compute Latency）。采用 LOGO 和 LOLO 交叉验证评估在未见 GPU/LLM 上的泛化能力，并与 TDP 基线和 roofline 基线对比。

Result: 在 42 个 LLM（0.1B–27B 参数）和 8 个 NVIDIA 服务器级 GPU 上的实验显示：功耗模型在未见 GPU 上的离线场景 MdAPE ≤3.4%，服务器场景 ≤13.5%；延迟模型在服务器场景 MdAPE ≤8.5%；服务器场景 GPU 排序 Kendall τ ≥0.76。相比 TDP 和 roofline 基线，在未见 LLM-GPU 组合上将 MdAPE 降低约 4 倍，对完全未见 GPU 降低约 2 倍。功耗主要由 GPU 特性（尤其是显存带宽相关特征）决定，ITL 则受带宽延迟主导。离线场景的 ITL 预测仍较难（LOGO MdAPE 24.9%），因 vLLM 连续批处理行为无法被静态特征完全捕获。

Conclusion: WattGPU 是首个在未见 GPU 上评估的 LLM 推理功耗和延迟预测模型，仅依赖公开数据无需剖析即可支持能效感知的部署决策（如 GPU 选择、模型匹配、容量规划），相比常用 TDP 和 TFLOPS/Watt 启发式更能反映真实能效（如 Llama 3.1 8B 在低负载服务器场景下选 A30 比 H100 节能 43%）。未来工作包括：引入工作负载感知特征以提升离线 ITL 预测精度、扩展到 MoE 和量化模型、以及集成到能效感知的工作负载调度和请求路由系统中。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference workloads are a rapidly growing contributor to data center energy consumption. Optimizing these deployments requires matching specific LLMs to the most efficient GPUs, but operators currently lack the tools to do so without exhaustively profiling each combination. While some predictive models exist, they still require profiling data and struggle to generalize to hardware unseen during training. To address this, we introduce \textit{WattGPU}, featuring two predictive models for mean GPU power draw and Inter-Token Latency (ITL). Our approach leverages only publicly available LLM metadata and GPU specifications, eliminating the need for hardware access or profiling while enabling generalization to unseen NVIDIA server-grade GPUs and LLMs. We evaluate our models using rigorous leave-one-GPU-out and leave-one-LLM-out cross-validation on a dataset of 42 open-source LLMs (0.1B--27B parameters) and 8 GPUs under both offline and server scenarios. The mean power draw model achieves a median absolute percentage error of $\leq3.4\%$ for offline and $\leq13.5\%$ for server scenarios on unseen GPUs, while the latency model achieves $\leq8.5\%$ in server mode, both maintaining strong GPU ranking correlations for server scenarios (Kendall $\tau\geq0.76$). Compared to standard physically grounded baselines -- Load-Scaled Thermal Design Power (TDP) for power draw and roofline for latency -- our models reduce median absolute percentage error by approximately 4$\times$ on unseen LLM-GPU combinations for server scenarios or approximately 2$\times$ for completely unseen GPUs. WattGPU's data and code are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [175] [FlintKV: A Fast Durable Storage Engine for Modern Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02401)
*Sergey Egorov,Gregory Chockler,Brijesh Dongol,Dan O'Keeffe,Sadegh Keshavarzi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FlintKV是一个针对非易失性内存（NVM）优化的跳表存储引擎，原生支持生产级键值存储的完整API，包括原子批处理写入、快照一致性迭代和持久线性化保证，并采用基于flat-combining的多版本并发控制算法，相比先前工作实现高达75%的端到端吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的NVM键值存储引擎虽然在数据写入和点查方面性能优异，但缺乏或未充分规范生产级键值存储所需的丰富接口保证（如时间点快照、一致性迭代器、原子批处理），而这些特性对于实现事务和并发控制至关重要，亟需一个能在NVM上原生支持完整API的存储引擎。

Method: 1. 基于跳表的数据结构，专门针对字节寻址NVM进行优化；2. 设计了新颖的flat-combining并发控制算法，结合多版本机制；3. 协同设计的持久化机制，确保持久线性化；4. 支持独立部署或将其持久化跳表集成到现有NVM存储中；5. 高效支持原子批处理写入和快照一致性迭代。

Result: 实证评估表明，FlintKV相比先前工作可实现高达75%的端到端吞吐量提升，同时保持完整的生产级API语义（包括点查、时间点快照、一致性迭代和原子批处理）。

Conclusion: FlintKV通过将flat-combining并发控制与多版本机制及NVM持久化设计深度融合，弥补了现有NVM键值存储在功能完整性方面的不足，在不牺牲性能的前提下提供了生产级接口保证，是一种实用且高效的NVM存储引擎方案。

Abstract: Byte-addressable non-volatile memory (NVM) offers an opportunity to rethink storage engine architectures. While recent NVM key-value stores achieve high throughput for ingestion and point lookups, they omit or under-specify the support for the richer interface guarantees required by modern databases. Production key-value engines (e.g., RocksDB) provide point-in-time snapshots, consistent iterators, and atomic batches-features essential for implementing transactions and concurrency control. We present FlintKV, an NVM-optimized skiplist-based storage engine that natively supports the full API of production key-value stores. FlintKV supports both atomic batch writes and snapshot-consistent iteration efficiently while guaranteeing durable linearizability. FlintKV can be deployed standalone or its durable skiplist can be integrated into existing NVM stores to enhance their capabilities. Central to FlintKV is a novel flat-combining based concurrency control algorithm that leverages multi-versioning and carefully co-designed persistence mechanisms to ensure high performance and scalability. Our empirical evaluation shows that FlintKV can achieve up to a 75% improvement in end-to-end throughput over prior work.

</details>
